jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering - MarTech & Loyalty
jobs.description:
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Director, Software Engineering reports to the Senior Director, Engineering and partners with them to establish and drive the technology solutions strategy and implementation to meet Macy’s business needs. The Director collaborates with technical and business functions across the enterprise, contributing to strategy and governance while making balanced technical decisions that consider code quality, delivery predictability, and, above all, business value.

The Director, Software Engineering maintains a strong engineering foundation with expertise in modern technology stacks and experience implementing contemporary technologies. This leader leverages managerial experience to guide and develop the existing engineering team, attract and recruit top engineering talent, and successfully lead large-scale technology implementations in retail or related industries.

What You Will Do

Evaluate and anticipate Macy’s future technology needs by balancing innovation, industry trends, and customer- and associate-facing solution requirements.
Lead the design, delivery, and operations of technology solutions that modernize Macy’s capabilities, providing strategic guidance to senior technology leadership on systems, processes, and improvements to support the business vision and strategic plan.
Stay current on emerging technologies, platforms, and best practices to ensure Macy’s technology stack remains modern and competitive.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to drive platform modernization and enterprise-wide technology initiatives.
Enhance software quality across Macy’s Technology organization, driving end-to-end accountability at all levels.
Own talent development and build bench strength within the technology organization, ensuring a strong pipeline of skilled leaders and contributors.
Mentor and coach leaders and individual contributors, actively raising the talent bar across the technology team.
Manage the portfolio’s budget, projects, and resource planning to ensure effective delivery and alignment with strategic priorities.
Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.
In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Technology Leadership & Strategy
: Proven ability to establish and drive technology strategy and solutions that align with business needs, balancing innovation, delivery predictability, and business value.

Software Engineering Expertise
: Strong foundation in modern technology stacks, open-source technologies, and cloud-native applications across private and public cloud platforms (GCP, Azure, AWS).

Large-Scale Technology Implementation
: Experience successfully leading large-scale technology initiatives, particularly in retail or highly matrixed organizations.

Agile Delivery & Execution
: Ability to deliver functional features rapidly in a fast-paced Agile environment, adapting to evolving priorities and business needs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
: Skill in partnering with technical and business teams to drive enterprise-wide initiatives, platform modernization, and operational improvements.

Software Quality & Process Governance
: Experience enhancing software quality, implementing best practices, and driving end-to-end accountability across teams.

Talent Development & Team Leadership
: Proven ability to attract, develop, and mentor engineering talent, building bench strength and raising the skill level across technology teams.

Offshore & Vendor Management
: Experience managing large offshore teams and third-party vendors is a plus.

Communication & Influence
: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills; able to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and influence decision-making at all levels.

Decision Making & Strategic Thinking
: Ability to balance short-term tactical decisions with long-term strategic vision, making sound judgments in ambiguous or challenging situations.

Problem Solving & Reasoning
: Demonstrates strong analytical and reasoning skills, able to work independently and make effective decisions with minimal supervision.

Negotiation & Stakeholder Management
: Strong negotiation skills and ability to build trust and influence across stakeholders in complex, matrixed environments.

Who You Are

This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include

Merchandise discounts
Performance-based incentives
Annual merit review
Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice
Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here .

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!

This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at macysJOBS.com.

jobs.description:
Join our team as the Director of Engineering
, where you’ll lead the charge in developing cutting-edge motors, blowers, pumps, and gearmotors for the Bison product line. This is a high-impact role that blends technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and strategic vision to drive product innovation and support our global manufacturing operations.

This role can be based in either our Kent, OH, Whitsett, NC or Aurora, IL site.

What You Will Do

Manage and lead new product development and product engineering functions for the Bison portfolio of motors, blowers, pumps, and gearmotors
Work at multiple levels of detail – from project-specific technical details, to high-level long-term planning. This role combines leadership responsibilities with hands-on involvement in day-to-day operations.
Be a key part of our stage-gate process for development programs, working closely with Application Engineering, Sales, Product Management, and Operations
Manage and lead VAVE efforts for your respective areas
Drive development programs, including managing scope, risk, schedule, and budget. Project management skills are key
Lead R&D efforts, in conjunction with Product Management, to ensure we’re saying current with trends and innovation in select areas and technologies
Prepare budgets and other financial reporting and tracking, in accordance with AMETEK expectations
Lead and work with teams that are both on-site at the same location, and also remote and global, including vendors, customers, and engineers that are in different time zones
Manage support for qualification and approvals for part re-sourcing, new components, and other production issues
Provide and ensure technical support for our manufacturing sites, to ensure on-time delivery and to meet quality expectations
Use your technical experience and knowledge to guide and make decisions and plans for individual development projects and for product lines
Support or lead meetings, training, or report-outs to customers, peers, or to corporate management. Ability to communicate well with all roles and levels is key.
Analyze and interpret data to make decisions
Lead and foster a sense of urgency and ownership within your team to drive a high-level of performance

We Are Looking For

Bachelor's degree in related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Master’s degree is a plus.
Minimum 3 years in a leadership/supervisory role
Minimum 3 years working for a manufacturer
Minimum 5 years working in a related field; experience with similar products a plus

Strong organizational, collaboration, and communication skills required
Demonstrated success in talent development
Demonstrated success in project management

Application deadline: Oct 9, 2026

Amazon Web Services is seeking a Director of Software Development to lead a team across North America and Europe building systems for cooling, power, telemetry and monitoring, and operational visibility across AWS' global data centers. In this role you will work backwards from a diverse set of engineering and operational use cases, and partner with leaders and builders across our data center ecosystem - from design engineering and mechanical/electrical engineering to controls engineering and engineering operations technicians. You will lead conceptualization of new software systems and evolution of existing software services, and deliver results through software development teams. You will partner with peer leaders across the broader data center team to align on strategic direction, and serve as a technical advisory voice to influence senior infrastructure leadership. And, of course, you will also be a people leader focused on hiring and growth of leaders and engineers on your team.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
10+ years of software development experience

10+ years experience driving long-term engineering and product decisions
Track record of delivering innovative cloud-based applications

Experience building software systems for the devices, sensors and control systems domains.
Experience solving customer and technical problems with durable, scalable solutions over multi-year, multi-billion dollar, and multi-organization impact.
Desire and ability to inspire and influence at all levels.
Experience driving complex, cross-organizational projects

jobs.description:
Barnsley Resort is a luxury destination located in the beautiful foothills of the Blue Ridge Mountains in Georgia, offering a unique and enchanting work environment for those seeking a fulfilling career in hospitality. As a job applicant, joining the team at Barnsley Resort means being part of a renowned property known for its stunning scenery, unparalleled amenities, and exceptional service. The resort offers a range of employment opportunities, from guest services to culinary, spa, and outdoor recreation, providing a diverse and rewarding career path. Barnsley Resort is committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive work culture that values teamwork, creativity, and outstanding guest experiences. Employees can expect to work in a serene and idyllic setting, where they can showcase their skills, grow their career, and be part of a team that delivers extraordinary experiences to guests. Joining the team at Barnsley Resort presents a unique opportunity to be part of a world-class resort that offers an unparalleled experience for both guests and team members alike.

Overview

Are you a visionary leader with a passion for innovation and a strong technical background? Join our team as the Director of Engineering and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our property. As the Director of Engineering, you will oversee a dynamic team and be responsible for the strategic planning, implementation, and management of all engineering operations. From enhancing energy efficiency to maintaining state-of-the-art facilities, you will ensure seamless operations and a superior guest experience. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, have a knack for problem-solving, and possess excellent leadership skills, this is the perfect opportunity for you to make a lasting impact in the hospitality industry.

Responsibilities

Develop and execute strategic plans to optimize engineering operations and enhance overall efficiency.
Oversee the maintenance, repair, and renovation of the property's infrastructure and systems.
Manage the engineering team, providing guidance, training, and mentorship to drive excellence.
Collaborate with other departments to ensure seamless integration of engineering services.
Implement sustainable and eco-friendly initiatives to promote energy conservation.
Monitor and analyze key performance indicators to drive continuous improvement.
Ensure compliance with safety and regulatory standards.
Foster a culture of innovation, teamwork, and exceptional service delivery.

Qualifications

Previous experience as a Director or Assistant Director required
Hotel, institutional, HVAC systems experience of 3-5 years
Refrigeration, HVAC certification
Working knowledge of electrical, mechanical, life safety systems, preventative maintenance systems etc
Budget management, cost control and financial responsibility experience with stationary engineering licensed preferred Valid Driver’s license
Ability to communicate effectively with public and other Team Members

In keeping with the company’s heritage of delivering value to its owners and team members, Davidson offers a rich benefit program with a variety of benefits designed to enrich the lives and well-being of our team members and their families.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Role and Responsibilities

The candidate will lead the engineering organization for a top contract manufacturer in the additive manufacturing industry, primarily focused on laser powder bed fusion and turnkey manufacturing support for customer-designed components.
The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic vision of the engineering team, aligning processes, tools, and innovation with the overall company growth plans. Due to the breadth of manufacturing scope we handle, this role requires considerable background knowledge in powder bed fusion, post-processing, heat treating, destructive and non-destructive testing, and finishing methods.
The ideal candidate has experience in a production environment, balancing safety, quality, cost, execution, and innovation to create an environment for company success and sustainable growth. Excellent interpersonal skills are critical for properly communicating with customers and internal stakeholders.
As a small business, this position requires the flexibility to seamlessly move from board room to production floor to address priorities.
Key focus areas for this position include:
Shaping the strategy of the company with input on industry trends and technology advancements
Supporting business development by serving customers well with technical support
Defining and optimizing engineering processes to enable consistent and efficient execution of work
Promoting continuous improvement, on-time delivery, and quality output
Solving problems as they arise with a collaborative approach
Driving innovation through industry/academic partnerships, consortiums, and internal RandD

Engineering and Manufacturing

Lead a team of Additive Manufacturing Engineers and Production Engineers through quoting, digital order loading, process definition, and technical support for production. This scope includes:
Assess design for manufacturability, material selection, equipment selection, and design optimization
Guide customers in the selection of materials
Develop content and best practices for design and manufacturability by establishing design guidelines to ensure lessons learned and best practices are documented
Create build files, layouts, and use cost estimation models
Prepare bills of material (BOM) and routings in an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system
Lead and provide technical direction for technicians
Provide "hands-on" support with printing and inspection equipment
Manage acquisition of necessary capital, maintenance contracts, consumables, and software to support growth strategies
Read and understand dimensional drawings, including GDandT
Analyze and specify post-processing steps such as heat treatment, finish machining, and coatings
Support and guide the root cause and corrective action (RCCA) process for technical issues

Customer Programs

Promote growth with key customers, new parts, and new industries by leading and supporting New Product Introduction (NPI).
Focus technology and process development to enable high-volume production.
Support the Project Management team in the following ways:
Assist in assembling quotations in response to customer RFQ's
Lead customer projects as the assigned project engineer
Prepare project schedules to define project scope deliverables
Lead and/or participate in regular customer meetings
Monitor and manage project costs in respect to the established budget
Anticipate problems and concerns relevant to project management and provide timely solutions
Coordinate document submittals, approvals, distribution, and revision control
Initiate purchase requisitions for tools, fixtures, operational equipment, and outside services
Maintain a strong working relationship with the customer
Occasional travel may be required to support project or program goals

Engineering echnical Programs / RandD

Lead advanced technical engineering programs (material/product/process development)
Lead statistical process control initiatives
Lead operational and supply chain cost reduction and optimization projects
Provide guidance on facility improvements, equipment selection, and in-sourcing

Qualifications And Education Requirements

Engineering degree in a related discipline (additive manufacturing, mechanical, metallurgical, etc.)
Minimum 12 years of experience in a production environment, including additive manufacturing, CNC machining, heat treating, and/or other metal fabrications technologies.
Prior experience must include technical roles and senior-level decision making roles with budget control.
Experience with the following software: CAD (e.g. SolidWorks, Catia), Build Preparation/Slice software (e.g. Materialise Magics, 3DExpert), Microsoft Office Suite

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Remote, North America

Reports to the CEO

About Pipe

Pipe builds embedded capital for small businesses. We deliver credit products inside the software platforms SMBs already use to run their business: vertical SaaS, payments platforms and marketplaces.

A merchant sees a pre-approved offer on the platform, reads the terms in seconds, accepts in four clicks, and repays as they earn. Behind that sit credit risk models, partner APIs and SDKs, money movement, and capital markets systems. Our capital is live inside Uber Eats Manager, Boulevard, Housecall Pro, GoCardless and other partners, across the US, UK, Canada, Australia and New Zealand.

Pipe’s revenue has accelerated almost 2.5 times year on year and is on track for profitability in the next few quarters. This candidate will work directly with the management team, have a core impact on the P&L and evolve an already model tech stack for new use cases in five countries.

We are remote-first. We ship fast, hold each other to a high bar, and leave egos at the door.

The role

You own Pipe's engineering output. This is a hands-on leadership role. You are in the codebase, in the architecture decisions, and in the incident channel when something breaks. You find the technical gaps, build the systems that scale with the business, and match engineering speed to what the business needs.

You lead about 10 engineers and stay technical enough to pair with an engineer or debug a production issue yourself.

What you'll do

Technical leadership and architecture

Own the health, scalability and reliability of Pipe's systems end to end, from partner-facing APIs and SDKs to money movement, capital markets infrastructure and AI/ML model infrastructure for credit underwriting.
Make and defend architectural decisions. Stay close enough to the code to know when a proposed design will not hold.
Set standards for code quality, testing, deployment and incident response that the team follows.
Sequence the technical roadmap against speed, scale and risk, starting with credit operations, liquidity tooling and partner integrations.

Team leadership and execution

Lead about 10 engineers through two squad leads. Set the technical bar. Unblock people directly.
Create clarity and momentum, and hold a pace the team can sustain.
Build a culture where engineers make the call and defend it.
Recruit, mentor and develop engineers as the team grows.

Cross-functional execution

Work with Product on scope, sequence and delivery.
Work with Risk and Data Science so infrastructure supports credit decisioning at scale.
Work with Capital Markets and Finance on money movement, reconciliation and reporting.
Represent engineering in partner technical conversations, including API and SDK integrations with platform partners.

Operational rigor

Own incident response and production reliability. You are in the room when something breaks, not told afterwards.
Build monitoring, alerting and on-call practices that catch issues before partners see them.
Improve code review, deployment and testing to raise velocity and hold quality.

What we're looking for

Required

6+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years leading a team of 5 or more engineers.
Experience at a fintech, a payments company, or another company running regulated financial systems.
Hands-on: you review code, debug production issues and make architectural calls yourself.
Track record of scaling engineering teams and systems at an early-stage or high-growth startup.
Experience owning business-critical infrastructure. Uptime, reliability and security are not optional at Pipe.
You work well with Product, Risk, Data Science, Capital Markets and Finance.
First-principles operator: you debug and fix production issues and technical debt yourself rather than delegating and forgetting them.
Comfortable working through imperfect systems and legacy tradeoffs.

Preferred

Payments, money movement or lending infrastructure.
Partner SDK and API integrations at scale, in embedded finance, marketplaces or platform partnerships.
Scaling an engineering team from Series A to Series C.
Credit risk or capital markets systems.

Compensation And Benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $280,000 - $330,000. The range may cover several career levels at Pipe and will narrow during the interview process based on experience, qualifications and location.

We are fully remote. As a Pipe employee you get:

The equipment you need to do the job
Flexible vacation and work hours
Health, dental and vision insurance
Parental leave for anyone growing their family, regardless of gender
Colleagues who work with authenticity and humility

jobs.title: Regional Director, Architecture & Engineering
jobs.description:
Regional Director, Architecture & Engineering

Phoenix, AZ

Our client is a growing, multidisciplinary architecture and engineering organization entering an exciting stage of expansion in the Southwest. They are seeking an accomplished regional leader to guide a high-performing Arizona operation, strengthen its architecture and engineering capabilities, and help shape the next chapter of the business. This is a highly visible leadership opportunity for someone who wants more than responsibility for a single discipline. The Regional Director will have meaningful influence across people, operations, client strategy, financial performance, project delivery, and long-term growth.

The ideal leader combines the commercial instincts of a business executive with the credibility to lead experienced architecture and engineering professionals. This person will inherit an established platform while having the opportunity to develop leaders, expand key relationships, improve business performance, and build an organization positioned for sustainable growth.

This Role Offers

Executive-level influence over the strategy and performance of a growing regional architecture and engineering operation.
Opportunity to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams while building the next generation of organizational leadership.
A highly collaborative environment that values entrepreneurial thinking, technical excellence, accountability, and strong client relationships.
Significant visibility with senior leadership and the ability to influence growth initiatives, organizational planning, and future expansion.
A role that combines strategic leadership with tangible ownership of financial, operational, talent, and client outcomes.
Competitive executive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including performance-based variable compensation and bonus opportunity, with potential stock or equity participation.
The resources of a broader organization combined with an environment that values local leadership, relationships, and market expertise.

Focus

Set the strategic direction for regional architecture and engineering operations, translating broader business priorities into measurable goals for growth, execution, and team performance.
Own regional business results across revenue, profitability, forecasting, utilization, staffing, resource planning, and overall operational health.
Recruit, coach, develop, and retain high-performing professionals while strengthening leadership capabilities and succession planning across the organization.
Unite architecture, engineering, project management, and supporting functions around an integrated approach to project delivery, quality, resource allocation, and client service.
Maintain executive oversight of significant projects, helping teams navigate delivery risks, contractual requirements, financial challenges, and complex client matters.
Strengthen relationships with key clients and prospects while partnering with practice leaders on business development, pursuit strategy, presentations, negotiations, and market expansion.
Identify and implement opportunities to improve workflows, communication, technology adoption, operational consistency, and scalable business practices.
Partner with senior leadership on strategic planning, organizational development, growth initiatives, and the integration of future expansion opportunities.
Represent the organization within the regional A&E community while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, professional development, and technical excellence.

Skill Set

Bachelor’s degree in architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, Engineering Management, or a related discipline.
15 or more years of progressive experience within architecture, engineering, multidisciplinary consulting, or a closely related professional services environment.
Significant leadership experience overseeing multidisciplinary teams, business operations, project delivery, client relationships, and organizational performance.
Demonstrated financial and business acumen, including responsibility for revenue, profitability, forecasting, utilization, staffing, and resource planning.
Proven ability to develop leaders, build high-performing teams, strengthen organizational capability, and successfully navigate periods of growth or change.

Requirements

Description & Requirements

Technology Director | Global Sourcing Technology

Who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

Global Supply Chain Technology delivers the platforms and capabilities that power lululemon’s supply chain—from raw material innovation and development, costing, sourcing, quality, sustainability and traceability, trade, logistics, and distribution technology. Our team works in close partnership with core business units to ensure that our supply chain remains agile, efficient, and responsive to ever-evolving market demands. By continuously innovating and refining our technological solutions, we enable best-in-class supply chain operations to service our Guests and our stores. This collaborative approach ensures we provide exceptional experiences and support lululemon’s growth in every community we serve.

The role

We are seeking a Technology Director to define and execute the multi year strategy for modernizing and transforming lululemon’s global sourcing technology ecosystem. This leader will shape the strategic roadmap, elevate costing and sourcing platform capabilities, advance AI driven decisioning, and ensure operational excellence across the systems that connect lululemon to its global vendor base.

You will own all aspects of technology for Global Sourcing—architecture, engineering, security, QA automation, operations, and delivery—and oversee a globally distributed team across North America and India. You will be accountable for the platforms that support approximately 300 raw material (RM) and finished goods (FG) vendors globally, and will partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering on the technology evolution required to support enterprise initiatives. This role requires a seasoned leader with a proven record of developing a strong leadership bench, managing complex solutions, and thriving in complex, fast paced, and highly collaborative environments.

This Role Oversees Technology Solutions Supporting

Product costing and should-cost modelling (materials, labor, overhead, landed cost)
Sourcing execution (quoting and RFQ, vendor award, capacity allocation and booking)
Purchase order management and order lifecycle for raw material and finished goods
Supplier collaboration portals and vendor-facing self-service
Partner connectivity (vendors, mills, agents, service providers)
Integration frameworks (EDI, APIs, event-driven architecture)
Master data and data quality for cost
Sourcing analytics, margin visibility, exception management, and operational dashboards

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Roadmap

Define and deliver a multi year global sourcing technology strategy that enhances scalability, reliability, and speed to market.
Translate business needs into an actionable engineering roadmap incorporating modernization, cloud migration, supplier collaboration, and responsible AI adoption.
Partner with business Directors, Sr. Directors, and VPs across Global Sourcing and Costing to define, deliver, and support the strategic roadmap.
Enroll cross functional technology partners in the strategic vision for Global Sourcing, and lead the creation and expansion of new capabilities that align with our strategic goals.

Platform & Architecture Modernization

Modernize existing costing and sourcing platforms and integrate next generation capabilities (costing engines, sourcing execution suites, or equivalent).
Drive transformation toward API-first, event-driven, and scalable integration architectures across the global vendor base.
Lead design and implementation of secure, resilient, and responsible data management and governance frameworks for material, vendor, and cost master data.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering on technology evolution that supports enterprise initiatives.

Engineering Leadership

Lead globally distributed engineering, QA automation, delivery, and support teams; develop managers and future-ready technical leaders.
Serve as the escalation point for Technology Managers to support delivery, making thoughtful decisions on the fly and constantly clearing roadblocks.
Raise engineering standards around quality, observability, security, and system reliability.
Build high performing, diverse teams with a culture of inclusion, transparency, and continuous improvement, and support career progression and stretch opportunities across the Global Sourcing technology area.

Operational Excellence

Oversee delivery, operations, and vendor/partner management across sourcing and costing systems, and own the relationship with key vendor partners.
Manage budgets for strategic initiatives and baseline opex for Global Sourcing technology, ensuring clear ROI and optimization of total cost of ownership.
Drive root cause analysis, systems reliability, service maturity, and measurable operational improvements.

Innovation & AI Enablement

Introduce AI-driven decision support for should-cost modelling, quote analysis, capacity allocation, vendor performance, and exception management.
Champion ethical, transparent, and responsible use of AI in sourcing and vendor-facing operations.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, related field, or commensurate relative experience.
15+ years of experience in technology, including 4+ years in a senior leadership position such as a Technology Manager or Technology Director.
Experience leading large scale initiatives and modernization efforts for supply chain platforms, with highly valued experience in costing and sourcing areas.
Proven success delivering transformations in areas such as product costing, sourcing execution, purchase order management, supplier collaboration, or vendor connectivity.
Strong background in integration architectures (API platforms, EDI, message streaming, event-driven design).
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or Java and familiarity with data engineering patterns.
Demonstrated ability to manage large budgets and deliver high-impact technology programs.
Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive influencing skills.
Continuous learning mindset that stays on the leading edge of sourcing and supply chain technology solutions that can bring value to the organization.
Experience with AI/ML use cases in supply chain, sourcing, or costing.
Understanding of apparel or consumer goods product development, raw materials, and global vendor management processes.
Experience working with distributed teams across multiple time zones and a global vendor base.

Success Metrics

Improved cost accuracy, margin visibility, and speed of costing cycles.
Reduced sourcing and purchase order cycle times, with fewer manual touches per order.
Improved reliability, uptime, and SLA performance of sourcing and costing systems.
Strong engagement scores and leadership development of global teams.

Must Haves

Acknowledges the presence of choice in every moment and takes personal responsibility for their life.
Possesses an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovates to achieve great results.
Communicates with honesty and kindness and creates the space for others to do the same.
Leads with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
Fosters connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
Integrates fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take themselves too seriously.

additional notes

jobs.description:
Artivion Overview

Headquartered in suburban Atlanta, Georgia, Artivion, Inc. is a medical device company focused on developing simple, elegant solutions that address cardiac and vascular surgeons’ most difficult challenges in treating patients with aortic diseases. Artivion’s four major groups of products include: aortic stent grafts, surgical sealants, On-X mechanical heart valves, and implantable cardiac and vascular human tissues. Artivion has over 1,600 employees worldwide with sales representation in over 100 countries. The Company has manufacturing facilities located in Atlanta, Georgia, Austin, Texas and Hechingen, Germany. Additionally, it has sales and distribution offices in various countries throughout Europe, Asia, and South America. For additional information about Artivion, visit our website, www.artivion.com.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Director of Infrastructure Operations & Strategy to provide strategic, operational, financial, and people leadership for enterprise infrastructure operations, engineering, and platform services across servers, storage platforms, cloud connectivity, data center services, monitoring, service restoration, and related resilience capabilities. Cybersecurity remains an enabling discipline, with the Director accountable for ensuring appropriate controls are embedded into infrastructure architecture, operations, lifecycle management, and recovery practices.

This role owns the infrastructure operations model, infrastructure roadmap, service reliability objectives, capacity and lifecycle planning, operational support processes, vendor and partner performance, and financial stewardship for the infrastructure portfolio. The Director supports the annual budgeting, forecasting, capital and operating expense planning process, budget variance management, and cost optimization while ensuring infrastructure operations and investments align with business priorities, risk tolerance, and enterprise technology strategy.

The successful candidate is expected to lead through managers, engineers, operations teams, and cross-functional partners while remaining sufficiently technical to guide architecture decisions, direct high-severity incident response, and support executive-level communication during critical events. The role balances strategic planning, operational execution, financial discipline, governance, and measurable improvement in service availability, resiliency, performance, scalability, and security posture.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Infrastructure Strategy, Engineering & Operations Leadership

Set the multi-year strategy, standards, and operating model for enterprise infrastructure operations and engineering across compute, storage, cloud, data center, and core platform services.
Lead the design, implementation, operation, and modernization of infrastructure services to meet availability, performance, scalability, recoverability, security, and supportability requirements.
Establish governance for architecture decisions, technical standards, lifecycle management, service ownership, operational readiness, change readiness, and production support.
Prioritize infrastructure operations and engineering initiatives based on business value, service reliability, risk reduction, regulatory needs, technical debt, and total cost of ownership.

Infrastructure Operations & Service Management

Own day-to-day infrastructure operations, including monitoring, incident response, change execution, service restoration, operational handoffs, and escalation management.
Establish and manage operating metrics for infrastructure services, including availability, performance, capacity, incident trends, change success rates, aging problems, and service-level performance.
Drive operational discipline through standard operating procedures, runbooks, knowledge management, event management, post-incident reviews, and continuous service improvement.
Ensure infrastructure operations are aligned with ITSM practices and integrated with service desk, application, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and business continuity processes.
Lead infrastructure operational readiness for new systems, acquisitions, integrations, site changes, manufacturing/plant requirements, and major business or technology initiatives.

Financial Management, Budgeting & Cost Optimization

Assist with infrastructure financial planning, including annual operating and capital budgets, multi-year investment planning, forecasting, and budget variance management.
Manage vendor spend, licensing, maintenance contracts, cloud consumption, hardware refresh cycles, managed services, and infrastructure project financials.
Partner with Finance, Procurement, Network, IT leadership, and business stakeholders to build business cases, track ROI, manage accruals, and support funding decisions.
Identify and execute cost optimization opportunities while preserving resilience, compliance, performance, and service quality.

Server, Compute & Platform Management

Oversee architecture, build, configuration, patching, performance, capacity planning, operations, and lifecycle management of physical, virtual, and cloud compute environments.
Ensure reliability and operational excellence across Windows, Linux, virtualization, and cloud compute platforms.
Drive standardization, automation, observability, and configuration management across compute environments.

Storage, Backup & Data Platform Leadership

Lead architecture and operations of enterprise storage platforms, including SAN, NAS, object, backup, replication, immutable storage, and cloud storage services.
Ensure data durability, recoverability, performance, encryption, retention alignment, and lifecycle management for critical enterprise data.
Define storage tiering, protection, replication, and recovery strategies aligned with business criticality, operational needs, and cost objectives.

Resilience, Disaster Recovery & Cyber Recovery

Assist and guide infrastructure disaster recovery, cyber recovery, and business continuity capabilities from a platform, operations, and service-readiness perspective.
Ensure systems are recoverable within defined RTO/RPO targets and that recovery capabilities are tested, documented, operationalized, and continuously improved.
Lead recovery planning and executive communication during high-severity outages, cyber events, operational disruptions, or resilience exercises.

People Leadership, Governance & Stakeholder Engagement

Lead, coach, and develop infrastructure engineering and operations teams; establish goals, performance expectations, succession plans, and talent development plans.
Develop clear operating rhythms for service reviews, operations reviews, project governance, financial reviews, incident reviews, problem reviews, and executive reporting.
Serve as a liaison between infrastructure operations, infrastructure engineering, cybersecurity, IT leadership, Finance, Procurement, business leaders, and external partners.
Communicate infrastructure service health, operational risks, financial outlook, project status, and investment priorities to executive leadership.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
12-18 years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, infrastructure operations, enterprise platforms, cloud, working knowledge of networking concepts related to systems, data center operations, or related technology leadership roles.
Minimum 5-8 years of people leadership experience, including leadership of managers, senior engineers, operations teams, distributed teams, or vendor/managed service teams.
Demonstrated experience owning departmental or portfolio-level budgets, including capital and operating expense planning, forecasting, budget variance management, vendor spend, managed service costs, and cost optimization.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Vice President AI/ML Software Engineer

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. Recognized as a top destination for innovators and champions of inclusion, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President AI/ML Software Engineer
to lead the architecture and delivery of production-grade AI systems built on agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and LLM orchestration. This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for a team of engineers building autonomous AI pipelines that extract, validate, and reason over complex unstructured documents. You will own the technical vision for a multi-agent ecosystem -- designing pipeline orchestration engines, embedding/vectorization strategies, knowledge retrieval systems, and AI-assisted code generation tooling. You will lead a VP-level engineer and a broader team of 4-8 developers. This role is in New York, NY

What Sets This Role Apart
- You build the agent framework, not just configure one -- custom orchestration engine, not a LangChain wrapper - Production AI with real consequences -- extraction accuracy directly impacts financial operations - Full RAG ownership -- from raw OCR bytes through embedding, retrieval, and generation - Evaluation-driven culture -- golden-truth datasets, automated regression, measurable quality gates - Greenfield AI + enterprise integration -- build new AI-native systems that plug into established platforms

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to impact on our organization in the following ways:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Architect agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning/reasoning loops, and autonomous decision chains - Design and evolve RAG infrastructure -- chunking strategies, embedding pipelines, vector store selection, retrieval ranking, and context window optimization - Define vectorization strategy: embedding model selection, dimensionality trade-offs, hybrid search (dense + sparse), and re-ranking approaches - Own the AI pipeline orchestration framework -- blocks, inlets/outlets, blackboards, memory stores, and content policy enforcement - Make build-vs-buy decisions across the AI toolchain (vector databases, agent frameworks, evaluation harnesses, model gateways) - Establish patterns for prompt engineering at scale: prompt versioning, chain-of-thought decomposition, few-shot management, and guardrails

Agentic & RAG Systems

Design multi-agent architectures with shared memory, blackboard patterns, and inter-agent communication protocols - Build autonomous extraction agents capable of planning, tool selection, self-correction, and validation - Implement knowledge graph construction from unstructured documents -- entity extraction, relationship mapping, and graph-based retrieval - Develop evaluation frameworks: retrieval precision/recall, extraction accuracy, agent task completion rates, and hallucination detection - Design feedback loops: human-in-the-loop correction, reinforcement from golden-truth datasets, and continuous prompt refinement

Team Leadership

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 4-8 engineers (AI/ML, backend, full-stack) - Directly manage a VP-level AI engineer; provide technical guidance and career development - Drive architecture reviews, design sessions, and technical decision-making - Own sprint planning, technical backlog, and delivery commitments - Foster a culture of rapid experimentation balanced with production rigor

Hands-On Engineering -

Implement core agentic components: agent loops, tool registries, memory persistence, and reasoning traces - Build embedding pipelines -- document preprocessing, chunk boundary detection, metadata enrichment, and vector index management - Develop scoring and validation systems (Bayesian confidence, cross-agent consensus, golden-truth comparison) - Contribute to platform services (Java/Spring Boot) and AI service layer (Python/FastAPI) - Build AI-assisted developer tooling: code generation workflows, automated test generation, and intelligent code review

Delivery & Operations

Own CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, and environment promotion - Define observability: agent execution traces, token usage tracking, retrieval quality metrics, and pipeline telemetry - Manage schema evolution and data stores (relational + vector) - Coordinate cross-team dependencies with platform engineering, data engineering, and infrastructure

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

Bachelor's degree or Advanced degree in computer science engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required. 10+ years of professional software engineering experience - 3+ years leading or technically mentoring engineering teams - Deep expertise in AI/ML systems: - LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, chain-of-thought reasoning - RAG architectures: chunking, embedding, retrieval, re-ranking, context assembly - Agentic patterns: ReAct, tool-use, planning loops, multi-agent coordination - Vector databases and embedding models (OpenAI embeddings, sentence-transformers, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar) - Strong Python (3.11+): FastAPI, async/await, Poetry, Pydantic, pytest - Solid Java experience: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, microservice architecture - Production AI delivery: not just prototypes -- systems handling real workloads with observability, error recovery, and audit trails - Document intelligence: OCR pipelines, NLP, structured extraction from unstructured text - Testing & evaluation: golden-truth validation, retrieval metrics (MRR, NDCG), extraction F1 scores, agent success rates - Enterprise architecture: API design, circuit breakers, caching, event-driven patterns

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building custom agent frameworks (not just using LangChain/CrewAI out-of-the-box) - Knowledge of graph-based retrieval -- knowledge graphs, graph RAG, entity-relationship extraction - Experience with code AI: AI-assisted development tools, code generation pipelines, automated refactoring - Familiarity with model fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, or RLHF techniques - Exposure to evaluation-driven development -- automated prompt regression testing, A/B testing of retrieval strategies - Angular/TypeScript experience for full-stack visibility - Capital markets or financial services domain knowledge - Familiarity with enterprise AI governance: content policies, PII handling, data residency

Technology Stack

AI/Agentic-
LLM orchestration, multi-agent systems, ReAct patterns, tool-use, autonomous pipelines

RAG & Vectors-
Embedding models, vector stores, hybrid search, re-ranking, chunk optimization

LLM-
Azure OpenAI, GPT-4o, enterprise model gateways, prompt versioning

Python-
Python 3.12/3.13, FastAPI, Poetry, Pydantic, async pipelines

Java-
Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, Maven, Resilience4j, Hazelcast

Frontend-
Angular 19, TypeScript, D3.js, ECharts

Database-
Oracle, PostgreSQL, vector databases

Infrastructure-
Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Artifactory

Observability-
Agent traces, token tracking, retrieval quality metrics, audit pipelines

jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Organizations are connecting industrial operations, modernizing control environments and integrating OT with enterprise technology. These changes create new cybersecurity, resilience and regulatory challenges across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors.

As an OT Cybersecurity Senior Manager in Technology Consulting, you will lead client engagements that assess, design and improve cybersecurity for Operational Technology and Industrial Control System environments. You will combine practical OT security knowledge with engagement leadership, client advisory, team development and business development. You will work across engineering, operations, cybersecurity and technology teams to help clients protect critical operations while supporting safety, availability and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead OT cybersecurity engagements, including maturity and risk assessments, architecture and configuration reviews, vulnerability assessments, security strategy, transformation roadmaps and implementation support.
Assess industrial environments that may include ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, SIS and IIoT technologies, industrial networks and supporting infrastructure.
Guide the design and implementation of practical OT security controls, including network segmentation, zones and conduits, defense in depth, system hardening, secure remote access, asset visibility, security monitoring and incident response capabilities.
Apply recognized OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82. Apply NIST CSF and sector-specific requirements when relevant to the client environment.
Lead client workshops and technical discussions with operational, engineering, cybersecurity and executive stakeholders. Translate technical findings into clear operational and business risk implications.
Manage engagement scope, workplans, resources, risks, quality, timelines and budgets. Keep client and EY stakeholders informed of progress and expected outcomes.
Lead, coach and develop engagement team members. Review deliverables and promote a collaborative, quality-focused and safety-aware working environment.
Build trusted client relationships and identify opportunities where EY can provide additional value.
Support business development through proposals, client presentations, solution shaping, methodology development, thought leadership and reusable assets.
Stay current on OT threat activity, industrial vulnerabilities, evolving regulations, security technologies and leading practices.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of industrial network architectures, industrial protocols and security controls used in OT environments.
Ability to turn technical observations into practical, prioritized recommendations that consider safety, availability, reliability and business continuity.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 8+ or more years of relevant cybersecurity, OT security, industrial automation or related experience.
Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.
Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCNA or comparable credentials.
Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

What We Look For

We are looking for professionals who combine OT and ICS technical credibility with practical consulting judgment. Successful candidates communicate clearly, collaborate across engineering, operations and cybersecurity teams, and deliver high-quality outcomes in complex industrial environments.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

The salary range for this job is:
New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $204,800 to $425,500
Bay Area California offices – $213,300 to $443,200
All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $170,600 to $390,000

Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

jobs.description:
Lead globally. Transform engineering. Deliver what matters.

At Sedgman, we’re redefining how engineering works at scale.

As Director Engineering, Systems & Digital
, you will step into a global leadership role shaping engineering governance, systems and digital capability across Sedgman’s international engineering network.

This newly created role will lead the global optimisation and transformation of engineering delivery. You will establish and embed best practice systems, standards and governance frameworks, while championing integrated digital engineering, data and AI-enabled solutions that improve productivity, quality, decision-making and delivery predictability.

This role can be based out of our Phoenix, Montreal or Vancouver offices. 

In this role, you will:

Lead the development and adoption of engineering governance frameworks, systems and standards that enable high-performing engineering delivery globally.

Provide functional leadership for global engineering systems, standards and governance, establishing scalable frameworks that drive consistency, quality and execution discipline across regions without direct operational ownership of engineering delivery teams.

Align engineering systems. processes and tools to enable efficient, seamless delivery at scale across complex project environments.

Champion the adoption of integrated digital engineering, data and AI-enabled capabilities to improve productivity, decision-making and delivery outcomes.

Establish a consistent global approach to engineering execution that enhances predictability, reduces risk and strengthens delivery performance.

Use data and performance insights to continuously improve quality, efficiency and overall project outcomes.

Drive strong commercial outcomes through effective governance of engineering systems, software vendors and strategic investments.

Partner with regional leadership to align engineering capability with business priorities, growth objectives and long-term performance.

What we’re looking for:

You’re a strategic and technically credible engineering leader with the ability to operate globally, influence change at scale and build the systems, standards and capability that enable high-performing engineering project delivery.

A degree-qualified engineering leader with 20+ years’ experience in engineering design across minerals processing, oil and gas, chemical or related sectors.

Senior leadership experience across complex, multi-discipline engineering teams.

Strong EPCM experience, including engineering systems integration and delivery governance.

Deep understanding of engineering applications, BIM/CDE environments and emerging digital engineering capability.

Demonstrated experience operating across regions, cultures and matrixed stakeholder groups.

Commercially astute, outcome-focused and confident translating strategy into execution.

Innovative, decisive and adaptable, with a continuous improvement mindset.

A strong communicator who can influence globally and bring teams with you through change.

Why this role?

This is a career-defining opportunity to transform how engineering is delivered globally, with real influence over systems, capability, governance and performance.

If you’re looking for more in your next move, you’ll find it here: more purpose in shaping how global engineering is delivered, more perspective through working across regions and complex projects, more progress through digital innovation, and more impact through measurable performance outcomes.

You’ll be supported by a business that values sustainable performance, wellbeing, flexibility and long-term career development.

What is in it for you?

Shape engineering at a global scale
by influencing delivery models, governance, capability building, digital innovation and performance across complex, international projects.

Accelerate your career with meaningful impact
in a business that supports flexibility, wellbeing and long-term development, while empowering you to drive measurable outcomes and lasting change.

Medical benefits

401k matching

Paid vacation, personal days and holidays

Discretionary bonus

The salary offered to the successful person for this position will consider education, experience, relevant skills and capability, geographic location and market conditions at the time of hire.

If this opportunity resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you. Submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant leadership experience and the impact you could bring to this role.

More in reach. 

Sedgman 
is part of the CIMIC Group’s mineral processing company and is a leading provider of mineral processing and associated infrastructure solutions to the global resources industry.  Our Mission is to generate sustainable returns for our shareholders by delivering projects for our clients while providing safe, rewarding and fulfilling careers for our people. We are a full project life cycle delivery company incorporating the development, project execution and ongoing operations phases of each project. Sedgman has offices in Australia, the Americas, Europe and Asia.

Our Values, The Sedgman Way:

At Sedgman, our principles support our mission and are a common bond. We can rely on each other for:  Integrity: being respectful and honest with ourselves, our colleagues, our clients, our partners, our suppliers and shareholders and other stakeholders.  

Accountability: committing to what we are responsible for.  

Innovation: continually adapting and evolving for the future.  

Delivery: amplifying our ability to deliver to drive our reputation and credibility.  

Sedgman is a proud equal opportunities employer, and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and barrier-free workplace that allows all our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success, and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates.  

We strongly support and encourage candidates with Indigenous ancestry (First Nations, Inuit, Métis) to self- identify and apply.

Choose Sedgman as your employer of choice - we look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Director, Global Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Why are we hiring for this role?

We're hiring a Director of Global Solutions Engineering
to lead the technical engine behind our revenue organization. As a cybersecurity company, our technical credibility is central to how we win and keep customers — and this leader owns it across the customer journey. You'll run a global, two-part function as a manager of managers: Sales Engineers
who drive the technical win in new business (pre-sales), and Solutions Consultants
who serve as the technical escalation path for our post-sales teams. You'll report directly to the CRO.

This is a builder's role for a leader who is equally comfortable in a strategy conversation with the executive team, in a technical deep-dive with an engineer, and jumping into a live customer call to lead it when it counts. Details of the remit are below.

Please note that we are only considering candidates who are in the PST time zone or Australia for this role.

What will you do?

Lead a global, multi-layered team. Manage and develop distributed managers and their teams of Sales Engineers and Solutions Consultants across regions. Hire, coach, and retain top technical talent; set clear career paths; and build a culture of technical excellence, curiosity, and customer obsession.
Own the technical win in pre-sales. Lead the Sales Engineering team to drive pipeline conversion through world-class demos, proofs of concept, technical discovery, and value engineering — consistently earning the technical decision.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Emerging Tech – New Technology Incubation
jobs.description:
Lab Summary

Samsung Research America's Emerging Technologies Group identifies and incubates innovative external technologies that accelerate Samsung's development and market position of its industry-leading consumer devices. We proactively research and create partnership & investment opportunities with breakthrough technologies that lay the foundation for the future of Samsung's core products & services across smartphones, tablets, wearables, PCs, TVs, appliances, and more. In addition to driving both the technical and business processes to validate and commercialize new technologies in Samsung's existing products, we maintain a strong pulse on the market to find the next big thing.

Position Summary

The Sr. Manager, Emerging Tech – New Technology Incubation is responsible for envisioning and championing transformative concepts that can evolve into next-generation products and services for Samsung. This role sits at the intersection of deep technology foresight, creative product thinking, and disciplined execution — translating bold ideas into structured R&D roadmaps and actionable partnership strategies.

In this role, you will ideate novel technology concepts grounded in market insight and emerging research, identify and engage external innovators across the North American startup and university ecosystems who can accelerate practical realization of those concepts, and build the strategic and organizational bridges needed to shepherd an idea from whiteboard to product. You will be equally comfortable presenting a speculative concept to a skeptical executive as you are diving into the technical merits of a promising early-stage technology with a university research team.

Position Responsibilities

Concept Ideation & Vision Setting: Generate and develop original technology concepts that address unmet consumer needs or create new market opportunities for Samsung, drawing on deep knowledge of emerging technology trends, competitive dynamics, and evolving consumer behavior
External Ecosystem Engagement: Navigate the North American startup landscape and university research community to identify early-stage innovations and research programs that can serve as building blocks for new product and service concepts; cultivate a broad and active network of founders, researchers, VCs, and technology transfer offices
R&D Roadmap Development: Translate validated concepts into structured R&D roadmaps that define the technical milestones, resource requirements, partnership touchpoints, and decision gates needed to advance an idea from concept through proof-of-concept and toward commercialization
Partnership Identification & Development: Identify and engage the right external partners — startups, academic labs, or research consortia — whose capabilities best complement Samsung's internal strengths; lead partnership discussions, structure collaborative evaluations, and drive proof-of-concept engagements with an eye towards longer-term commercialization, investment, or M&A
Executive Storytelling & Advocacy: Develop compelling narratives around new technology concepts — including business cases, opportunity assessments, and strategic rationales — and present them persuasively to senior Samsung leadership across R&D and business units globally; serve as the internal champion for incubation initiatives from inception through executive approval
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Engage and align multiple R&D labs, product divisions, and business units across Samsung's global organization to build internal momentum behind new concepts; coordinate cross-functional and cross-geo teams, define project milestones, and drive accountability to timelines and deliverables
Market & Technology Intelligence: Maintain a continuously updated perspective on breakthrough advances across relevant technology domains; synthesize signals from academic publications, patent landscapes, startup activity, and industry events to inform and refine the concept pipeline
Ambiguity Navigation: Proactively structure loosely defined problem spaces into actionable frameworks, bringing clarity and momentum to early-stage initiatives where the path forward is inherently uncertain

Required Skills

Bachelor's degree in a technology or engineering discipline required (e.g., EE, CS, or similar); post-graduate degree (MS, PhD, and/or MBA) or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
8+ years of professional experience spanning technology research, product strategy, or engineering, with a demonstrated track record of taking novel technology concepts from ideation to tangible outcomes (products, partnerships, or funded programs)
Broad technical fluency across multiple emerging technology domains (e.g., AI/ML, sensing, AR/XR, robotics, digital health, wireless technologies) with the ability to quickly develop working knowledge in new areas
Proven ability to originate and develop compelling technology concepts, not just evaluate externally presented ones
Demonstrated experience building and executing R&D roadmaps for early-stage, ambiguous technology initiatives
Effective interpersonal and relationship management skills, with a strong personal network within the startup, venture, and university research communities
Experience leading complex, multi-team, and cross-geographic projects to successful outcomes
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor complex technical and strategic narratives to executive, technical, and business audiences alike
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly ambiguous environment and drive progress without well-defined playbooks
Must be willing to travel domestically and internationally (20%)

Special Attributes

Intellectual curiosity and the creativity to imagine products and experiences that do not yet exist
Entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable with risk, energized by ambiguity, and motivated by the prospect of building something genuinely new
Great communication skills: clear, patient, and well adapted to audience and situation — equally fluent in the language of technology and business
Analytical rigor to ground speculative concepts in structured, evidence-backed recommendations and respond credibly to executive challenges and objections
Strong organizational instincts to manage multiple incubation threads simultaneously, balancing long-horizon thinking with near-term execution
Ability to build trust and followership across internal stakeholders and external partners alike, without direct authority over either

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a Senior Manager in the R&I Independence Technology Team (ITT), you will play a pivotal role in maintaining regulatory compliance and managing risks for clients, providing advice and solutions. Within our Internal Firm Services practice, you will focus on identifying and mitigating potential risks that could impact an organization's operations and objectives. You will be responsible for developing business strategies to effectively manage and navigate risks in a rapidly changing business environment.

As a Senior Manager, you will leverage your skills and professional network to deliver quality results. You will motivate and coach others, coming together to solve complex problems. With increased autonomy, you will apply sound judgment, recognizing when to take action and when to escalate. Your ability to develop and sustain high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, and your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our firm.

In this role, you will craft and convey clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story. You will apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities, validate outcomes with stakeholders, and share alternative perspectives. Your leadership will guide the team through complexity, demonstrating composure through ambiguous, challenging, and uncertain situations.

Responsibilities

Leading enterprise risk management initiatives to identify and mitigate potential risks impacting organizational operations and objectives
Developing business strategies to effectively manage risks in a rapidly changing environment
Applying analytical thinking to assess business risk and implement mitigation measures
Crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story to stakeholders
Directing teams through complex situations, demonstrating composure and strategic questioning
Validating outcomes with stakeholders and acting on feedback to improve risk management processes
Modeling and reinforcing professional and technical standards, including the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements
Initiating open and honest coaching conversations to develop high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams
Utilizing business process improvement techniques to enhance internal controls and regulatory compliance
Building relationships with business leaders to identify and address risk challenges effectively

What You Must Have

At least a High School Diploma or the equivalent degree
At least 6 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Finance, Risk Management/Insurance
Demonstrating advanced skills in Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
Utilizing Business Process Improvement techniques to drive results
Applying systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities
Excelling in contract negotiation and contractual risk mitigation
Leading teams through complexity with composure and strategic questioning
Developing and sustaining diverse and inclusive high-performing teams

Define and communicate the strategic technology vision for engineering teams, ensuring engineering initiatives support organizational goals and product priorities.

Establish, maintain, and enforce engineering standards, software development best practices, technical quality controls, and processes supporting reliable software delivery.
