jobs.title: Cyber - Operational Technology - Senior Manager - Consulting
jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Organizations are connecting industrial operations, modernizing control environments and integrating OT with enterprise technology. These changes create new cybersecurity, resilience and regulatory challenges across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors.

As an OT Cybersecurity Senior Manager in Technology Consulting, you will lead client engagements that assess, design and improve cybersecurity for Operational Technology and Industrial Control System environments. You will combine practical OT security knowledge with engagement leadership, client advisory, team development and business development. You will work across engineering, operations, cybersecurity and technology teams to help clients protect critical operations while supporting safety, availability and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead OT cybersecurity engagements, including maturity and risk assessments, architecture and configuration reviews, vulnerability assessments, security strategy, transformation roadmaps and implementation support.
Assess industrial environments that may include ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, SIS and IIoT technologies, industrial networks and supporting infrastructure.
Guide the design and implementation of practical OT security controls, including network segmentation, zones and conduits, defense in depth, system hardening, secure remote access, asset visibility, security monitoring and incident response capabilities.
Apply recognized OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82. Apply NIST CSF and sector-specific requirements when relevant to the client environment.
Lead client workshops and technical discussions with operational, engineering, cybersecurity and executive stakeholders. Translate technical findings into clear operational and business risk implications.
Manage engagement scope, workplans, resources, risks, quality, timelines and budgets. Keep client and EY stakeholders informed of progress and expected outcomes.
Lead, coach and develop engagement team members. Review deliverables and promote a collaborative, quality-focused and safety-aware working environment.
Build trusted client relationships and identify opportunities where EY can provide additional value.
Support business development through proposals, client presentations, solution shaping, methodology development, thought leadership and reusable assets.
Stay current on OT threat activity, industrial vulnerabilities, evolving regulations, security technologies and leading practices.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of industrial network architectures, industrial protocols and security controls used in OT environments.
Ability to turn technical observations into practical, prioritized recommendations that consider safety, availability, reliability and business continuity.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 8+ or more years of relevant cybersecurity, OT security, industrial automation or related experience.
Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.
Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCNA or comparable credentials.
Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

What We Look For

We are looking for professionals who combine OT and ICS technical credibility with practical consulting judgment. Successful candidates communicate clearly, collaborate across engineering, operations and cybersecurity teams, and deliver high-quality outcomes in complex industrial environments.

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

jobs.description:
Description

As the Director of AWS Professional Services (ProServe) AWS Growth Initiatives (AGI), you will lead AWS's most ambitious customer transformation initiative: driving enterprise adoption of AI-powered modernization programs that help customers reduce costs by up to 70% while accelerating their cloud journey. In this role, you'll architect and scale repeatable pathways that transform how enterprises migrate from legacy environments to AWS, modernize their security posture, and leverage state-of-the-art AI tooling to compress 12-18 month projects into 3-month engagements.

Your days will alternate between strategic planning to refine AI-powered discovery approaches, presenting to C-suite executives on transformation initiatives with quantified business outcomes, and cross-functional collaboration with the global AWS sales and SA teams, ProServe sales and delivery teams, WWSO Security teams, and partner organizations. You'll balance tactical execution (with strategic vision, building sustainable programs that scale across thousands of customers. Throughout, you'll make high-velocity decisions on resource allocation, pricing strategies, and partnership models while reviewing annual planning documents and refining multi-year roadmaps that shape organizational priorities. This role sits at the intersection of strategic business development, technical innovation, and executive relationship management—where your decisions directly impact AWS's growth trajectory and customer success at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Define and execute multi-year strategy for AGI programs, developing repeatable pathways that scale from dozens to thousands of customer engagements through AI-powered automation
Engage customer C-suite and line-of-business leaders on transformation initiatives, translating technical capabilities into quantified business outcomes and executive-ready business cases
Drive cross-organizational alignment across Sales, Strategic Customer Engagement, Geography teams, Product, and Partner organizations to ensure seamless program execution
Design and implement scaled delivery models that leverage partner ecosystems while maintaining quality governance and operational excellence
Build and lead multi-layered organization spanning business development, technical specialists, and program managers with clear succession plans and sustainable workload culture
Own pipeline generation and management through AI-powered opportunity identification, monitoring conversion rates, deal velocity, and program health metrics
Make high-velocity decisions on resource allocation, pricing strategies, deal qualification, and risk management with significant business impact
Participate in OP1/OP2 planning, 3-year strategic roadmaps, and organizational planning processes that shape AWS priorities
Champion adoption of AI-powered business development tools and methodologies, driving continuous improvement in delivery effectiveness and customer outcomes
Manage financial planning, P&L responsibility, and operational compliance across programs while balancing growth targets with margin optimization

About The Team

The AWS Professional Services AGI team is an AI-first business development engine designed to accelerate customer adoption and drive large-scale transformation deals globally using scalable mechanisms. Our AGI programs provide standardized, repeatable pathways that help customers navigate complex cloud journeys—from initial migration through modernization to AI-native innovation.

The AGI team operates at the forefront of AWS's growth strategy, combining deep technical expertise with strategic business development to unlock opportunities across our largest and most strategic accounts. We work closely with Enterprise Strategists, Expert Services, delivery teams, and partner organizations to create seamless customer experiences that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years experience in business development, sales, or customer-facing roles in enterprise technology
7+ years managing teams, including experience leading managers and multi-layered organizations
Experience developing and executing multi-year strategic plans with measurable business outcomes
Demonstrated ability to engage C-suite executives and line-of-business leaders on transformation initiatives
Experience with cloud computing, enterprise software, or technology services business models
Background managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs spanning multiple teams or business units
Knowledge of cloud security services, security assessments, or security transformation programs
Working understanding of AI/ML technologies and their application to enterprise modernization, including generative AI tooling, AI-powered automation, or AI-driven discovery and migration approaches

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Background in Microsoft technologies, application modernization, or database migration programs
Cloud security services expertise including security assessments or security transformation programs
Track record designing and scaling repeatable go-to-market programs or standardized service offerings
MBA or advanced degree in relevant field

The Opportunity

As a Senior Manager in the R&I Independence Technology Team (ITT), you will play a pivotal role in maintaining regulatory compliance and managing risks for clients, providing advice and solutions. Within our Internal Firm Services practice, you will focus on identifying and mitigating potential risks that could impact an organization's operations and objectives. You will be responsible for developing business strategies to effectively manage and navigate risks in a rapidly changing business environment.

As a Senior Manager, you will leverage your skills and professional network to deliver quality results. You will motivate and coach others, coming together to solve complex problems. With increased autonomy, you will apply sound judgment, recognizing when to take action and when to escalate. Your ability to develop and sustain high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, and your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our firm.

In this role, you will craft and convey clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story. You will apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities, validate outcomes with stakeholders, and share alternative perspectives. Your leadership will guide the team through complexity, demonstrating composure through ambiguous, challenging, and uncertain situations.

Responsibilities

Leading enterprise risk management initiatives to identify and mitigate potential risks impacting organizational operations and objectives
Developing business strategies to effectively manage risks in a rapidly changing environment
Applying analytical thinking to assess business risk and implement mitigation measures
Crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story to stakeholders
Directing teams through complex situations, demonstrating composure and strategic questioning
Validating outcomes with stakeholders and acting on feedback to improve risk management processes
Modeling and reinforcing professional and technical standards, including the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements
Initiating open and honest coaching conversations to develop high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams
Utilizing business process improvement techniques to enhance internal controls and regulatory compliance
Building relationships with business leaders to identify and address risk challenges effectively

What You Must Have

At least a High School Diploma or the equivalent degree
At least 6 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Finance, Risk Management/Insurance
Demonstrating advanced skills in Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
Utilizing Business Process Improvement techniques to drive results
Applying systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities
Excelling in contract negotiation and contractual risk mitigation
Leading teams through complexity with composure and strategic questioning
Developing and sustaining diverse and inclusive high-performing teams

jobs.title: Cyber - Operational Technology - Senior Manager - Consulting
jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Organizations are connecting industrial operations, modernizing control environments and integrating OT with enterprise technology. These changes create new cybersecurity, resilience and regulatory challenges across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors.

As an OT Cybersecurity Senior Manager in Technology Consulting, you will lead client engagements that assess, design and improve cybersecurity for Operational Technology and Industrial Control System environments. You will combine practical OT security knowledge with engagement leadership, client advisory, team development and business development. You will work across engineering, operations, cybersecurity and technology teams to help clients protect critical operations while supporting safety, availability and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead OT cybersecurity engagements, including maturity and risk assessments, architecture and configuration reviews, vulnerability assessments, security strategy, transformation roadmaps and implementation support.
Assess industrial environments that may include ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, SIS and IIoT technologies, industrial networks and supporting infrastructure.
Guide the design and implementation of practical OT security controls, including network segmentation, zones and conduits, defense in depth, system hardening, secure remote access, asset visibility, security monitoring and incident response capabilities.
Apply recognized OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82. Apply NIST CSF and sector-specific requirements when relevant to the client environment.
Lead client workshops and technical discussions with operational, engineering, cybersecurity and executive stakeholders. Translate technical findings into clear operational and business risk implications.
Manage engagement scope, workplans, resources, risks, quality, timelines and budgets. Keep client and EY stakeholders informed of progress and expected outcomes.
Lead, coach and develop engagement team members. Review deliverables and promote a collaborative, quality-focused and safety-aware working environment.
Build trusted client relationships and identify opportunities where EY can provide additional value.
Support business development through proposals, client presentations, solution shaping, methodology development, thought leadership and reusable assets.
Stay current on OT threat activity, industrial vulnerabilities, evolving regulations, security technologies and leading practices.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of industrial network architectures, industrial protocols and security controls used in OT environments.
Ability to turn technical observations into practical, prioritized recommendations that consider safety, availability, reliability and business continuity.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 8+ or more years of relevant cybersecurity, OT security, industrial automation or related experience.
Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.
Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCNA or comparable credentials.
Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

What We Look For

We are looking for professionals who combine OT and ICS technical credibility with practical consulting judgment. Successful candidates communicate clearly, collaborate across engineering, operations and cybersecurity teams, and deliver high-quality outcomes in complex industrial environments.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

The salary range for this job is:
New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $204,800 to $425,500
Bay Area California offices – $213,300 to $443,200
All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $170,600 to $390,000

Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Security Engineering
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

Senior Manager, Security Engineering

Business Technology, Security

REPORTING AREA

Security - CISO

FUNCTION

Business Technology

TEAM MODEL

United States and India

LEADERSHIP SCOPE

Application/Product Security; Infrastructure/Cloud Security; Vulnerability Management

ROLE TYPE

Leader with technical depth

ENVIRONMENT

AI-first, cloud-native SaaS

Role Purpose

Lead the security engineering organization that protects 6sense's AI-enabled, cloud-native SaaS platform. This leader owns Vulnerability Operations, Infrastructure Security, and Application/Product Security, and is accountable for building scalable security capabilities that enable rapid product delivery without compromising customer trust, resilience, or compliance. The role leads a distributed team across the United States and India and combines strategic leadership with credible technical judgment.

Leadership Mandate

Build one integrated security engineering operating model across the three teams, with clear ownership, service expectations, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Data, AI/ML, Security Operations, Privacy, GRC, and Enterprise Technology leaders to embed security into planning and delivery.
Create an inclusive, high-accountability culture across time zones using clear decisions, durable documentation, effective handoffs, and intentional overlap for critical work.
Balance hands-on technical engagement with people leadership, program ownership, stakeholder influence, and executive-level risk communication.

Core Responsibilities

Organization and People Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop managers and engineers across the United States and India. Establish role clarity, career paths, succession coverage, and consistent performance expectations.
Create an operating cadence that supports asynchronous execution, reliable cross-region handoffs, rapid escalation, and shared accountability.
Build workforce and capacity plans aligned to product growth, AI investment, risk, and business priorities.
Foster a culture of constructive challenge, disagree and commit, continuous learning, quality, and automation-first improvement.
AI and Product Security
Own the security strategy for AI-enabled product capabilities from design through production, including threat modeling, architecture review, secure development standards, testing, monitoring, and release readiness.
Address AI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool or agent access, sensitive-data exposure, model and data pipeline integrity, excessive agency, abuse, and third-party model or service dependencies.
Partner with AI/ML, Product, and Engineering teams to define secure patterns for models, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, application programming interfaces, data access, and human approval controls.
Advance product security practices including secure software development lifecycle controls, code and design review, application security testing, penetration testing, security champions, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure or bug bounty.
Vulnerability Operations
Own end-to-end vulnerability discovery, prioritization, remediation governance, exception management, and validation across applications, cloud infrastructure, containers, endpoints, operating systems, and third-party components.
Move beyond severity-only prioritization by incorporating exploitability, internet exposure, asset criticality, data sensitivity, available compensating controls, and active threat intelligence.
Improve remediation speed and predictability through automation, clear service-level objectives, transparent ownership, and decision-ready reporting.
Establish effective coverage for software supply chain risk, including open-source dependencies, build systems, artifacts, secrets, and continuous integration and delivery pipelines.
Infrastructure and Cloud Security
Own preventive and detective security guardrails for the AWS environment, infrastructure as code, containers, identity and access, network boundaries, workloads, secrets, logging, and data services.
Partner with Infrastructure and Platform Engineering to make secure cloud patterns easy to adopt and to reduce reliance on manual review.
Drive least privilege, secure administrative access, workload identity, segmentation, configuration assurance, and continuous cloud risk reduction.
Ensure architecture and change reviews focus on material risk while preserving engineering velocity.
Strategy, Governance, and Business Partnership
Translate business strategy, product roadmaps, AI priorities, threat trends, customer commitments, and audit requirements into a multi-quarter security engineering roadmap.
Define quarterly objectives and key results, key performance indicators, and key risk indicators that show coverage, outcomes, trends, and remaining exposure.
Communicate risk and tradeoffs clearly to technical leaders and executives. Escalate material risks with practical options, owners, and recommended decisions.
Maintain policies, standards, control evidence, inventories, and operating procedures that support SOC 2, ISO 27001, privacy, customer assurance, and other applicable obligations.
Evaluate and rationalize security tools and services based on measurable risk reduction, engineer experience, coverage, integration, and total cost.

Success Measures

Success will be measured by outcomes and sustained operating health, not activity volume alone:

Risk reduction

Material vulnerabilities and security design risks are identified early, prioritized consistently, and remediated or formally accepted within defined objectives.

Coverage

Security controls and testing provide measurable coverage across product code, AI features, cloud infrastructure, containers, identities, dependencies, and critical data paths.

Engineering velocity

Approved secure patterns, automation, and self-service controls reduce security friction and late-stage rework.

AI security readiness

AI features have repeatable security requirements, threat models, tests, release criteria, monitoring, and documented residual risk.

Operational maturity

The three teams operate with clear ownership, reliable cross-region handoffs, actionable metrics, current documentation, and effective escalation.

People and leadership

The organization demonstrates strong engagement, skill growth, succession depth, retention, and accountable delivery across locations.

Stakeholder trust

Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and executive partners receive timely, clear, decision-ready security guidance and reporting.

Required Experience And Capabilities

8+ years in information security, including significant experience in product or application security, cloud security, vulnerability management, or security engineering.
3+ years leading security engineering teams, including experience managing distributed or cross-region teams. Experience leading managers is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to build and mature security programs in a cloud-native SaaS environment, preferably on AWS.
Practical experience securing modern software delivery, including secure development lifecycle practices, application security testing, cloud-native infrastructure, containers, infrastructure as code, software supply chain, and vulnerability operations.
Working knowledge of AI and machine learning security risks and controls. Experience securing large language model, agentic, or retrieval-augmented generation features is strongly preferred.
Ability to evaluate technical risk, make sound tradeoffs, and convert strategy into clear roadmaps, operating mechanisms, and measurable outcomes.
Strong executive and technical communication skills, including the ability to explain complex risk in plain language and influence without relying on authority.
Knowledge of relevant practices and frameworks such as NIST Secure Software Development Framework, OWASP, OWASP guidance for large language model applications, MITRE ATLAS, CIS Benchmarks, NIST 800-53, SOC 2, and ISO 27001.

Technical Domain Familiarity

Application and product security: threat modeling, architecture review, static and dynamic testing, code review, penetration testing, security champions, application programming interface security, and bug bounty or coordinated disclosure.
Cloud and infrastructure security: AWS, cloud security posture management, cloud-native application protection, identity and access management, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, secrets, operating system hardening, and logging.
Vulnerability and supply chain security: scanners, risk-based prioritization, dependency and artifact security, software bills of materials, build pipelines, remediation governance, and exception management.
AI security: model and data access, prompt injection, agent and tool permissions, retrieval security, output handling, data leakage prevention, red teaming, abuse monitoring, and third-party AI service risk.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Relevant certification such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or an advanced cloud security certification.
Experience in a high-growth business-to-business SaaS company and in customer-facing security assurance.

Leadership Behaviors

Leads with clarity, trust, accountability, and sound judgment.
Develops people and creates space for strong technical leaders to lead.
Prioritizes based on business impact and risk, not noise or tool output.
Communicates early, directly, and in plain language.
Uses data to guide decisions while recognizing where judgment is required.
Challenges constructively, commits to decisions, and follows through.
Stays current on modern threats affecting cloud-native SaaS and AI-enabled products.

Base Salary Range: $204,721.50 - $254,258.20. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO).

jobs.description:
About Us

Inventus Power is a global leader in advanced battery systems that specializes in designing and manufacturing high-quality, reliable, and innovative power systems for a broad range of portable, motive, and stationary applications. We are a US based company headquartered in Woodridge, Illinois and have a global presence that extends across four continents with five manufacturing facilities, three engineering technical centers, a multi-tiered sales service channel, and 3,000+ employees. For over 60 years, Inventus Power has been addressing the rapidly expanding power demands of a changing world through technology and engineered solutions. We continue to invest in our people and processes, while enhancing our products and capabilities in order to create a safer, smarter, and more sustainable battery-powered world.

We are an ITAR facility and hire only U.S. persons who are defined as U.S. citizens or green card holders.

What You’ll Do

The Director of Cell Technology is responsible for executing Inventus Power's battery cell technology strategy to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and long-term business growth. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this role serves as the company's technical authority on battery cell technologies while leading strategic partnerships, advancing intelligent battery solutions, and representing Inventus as an industry thought leader.
This position works cross-functionally with Engineering, Product Management, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and key external partners to evaluate emerging technologies, support customer engagements, and ensure Inventus remains at the forefront of battery innovation.

Responsibilities (Including other duties as assigned)

Develop and execute the company's battery cell technology roadmap aligned with business objectives.
Evaluate emerging battery chemistries, cell technologies, and industry trends to identify opportunities for innovation and product differentiation.
Lead the development of Inventus Power's Battery Intelligence platform by leveraging internal cell test data, field performance data, and strategic collaboration with our partners
Provide technical direction for next-generation battery technologies, product development, and commercialization.

Strategic Partnerships

Identify, establish, and maintain strategic relationships with leading battery cell manufacturers and technology partners.
Develop partners to support North American battery supply chain
Build collaborative partnerships with universities, national laboratories (including Argonne National Laboratory), government agencies, and research organizations to accelerate innovation.
Evaluate and promote new technologies that strengthen Inventus Power's competitive position.

Technical Leadership

Serve as Inventus Power's subject matter expert on battery cell technologies.
Provide technical leadership and consultation across Engineering, Quality, Operations, Product Management, Supply Chain, and Executive Leadership.
Support customer meetings, technical reviews, and business development activities as the company's battery cell expert.
Mentor engineering teams and foster technical excellence across the organization.

Customer & Industry Leadership

Partner with Sales to communicate technology roadmaps and emerging battery innovations to strategic customers.
Represent Inventus Power at customer meetings, industry conferences, technical forums, and trade organizations.
Collaborate with Marketing to develop technical papers, presentations, and thought leadership content.
Actively participate in industry organizations and standards committees, including NAATBatt, MPSC, SAE, and other relevant technical working groups

What You Will Need

Preferred Advanced degree in Electrochemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred.
10+ years of experience in battery cell technology, advanced energy storage, or related fields. Experience at major cell manufacturing entities is highly valued.
Deep expertise in lithium-ion battery technologies, cell characterization, battery management systems, and emerging battery technologies.
Proven experience developing technology strategies, leading innovation initiatives, and establishing strategic technical partnerships.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts to customers, executive leadership, and industry audiences.
Strong leadership, collaboration, and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.
Be available on site for meetings with suppliers, customers, and internal teams on a regular basis.

Travel

Up to 30% domestic and international travel to support customers, strategic partners, supplier relationships, research collaborations, and industry events.

Inventus Power is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and affirmative action employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Customer Health & Critical Accounts
jobs.description:
The Role

MongoDB is building two connected capabilities that determine how we protect and grow our most important customer relationships: a Critical Accounts program that catches at-risk accounts early and drives them to a durable resolution, and a Customer Health Platform, an AI-powered one-stop shop for customer insights, combining health, adoption, engagement, and experience data with proactive risk identification and recommended actions.

This role owns both. You will build and lead the Critical Accounts function end to end: the framework, the global operating model, and the executive reporting that gives leadership real-time visibility into the portfolio. You will also set the long-term vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform: what it scores and alerts on, which teams and use cases it serves next, and how it becomes the one-stop shop for customer insight across the company. You will be accountable for how MongoDB identifies, intervenes on, and learns from customer risk, and for where the Customer Health platform goes next.

This is a build role. You are creating the operating rhythm, the standards, and the team structure as much as you are running them.

This role can be based out of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

What You Will Do

Own and Build the Critical Accounts Program

Design and iterate on the global Critical Accounts framework: entry/exit criteria, account archetypes, playbooks, health assessment templates, and Get Well Plan standards.
Design the central Critical Accounts org structure and hire a lean program management team, establishing this as a durable, well-resourced function within Customer Strategy. This team is the connective tissue that ensures every qualifying account is triaged, resourced, tracked, and ultimately graduated with documented outcomes.
Own intake and triage standards so every qualifying nomination is validated, classified, and assigned a process lead and resource plan without delay.
Design the path for Critical Accounts to move beyond human nomination alone, working with Customer Health to define the signals and thresholds that proactively detect at-risk accounts and surface them for the cohort, so nominations come from both human judgment and the platform's early-warning detection.
Own program coordination: the master tracker of active critical accounts, cross-functional stand-ups with Customer Success, Technical Support, Professional Services, Sales, and Product and Engineering, the 90-day checkpoint process, and resource rebalancing as account needs evolve.
Own executive reporting for the program: weekly account status, monthly portfolio readouts with trend analysis, and quarterly summaries covering program KPIs, churn prevented, and cost-to-save ratios.
Set and track program KPIs, de-escalation rate, time-to-exit, CSAT delta, churn prevented, resource hours per account, and refine investment tiers based on actual data.
Lead post-mortem reviews for every graduated account and route findings into QBRs, product prioritization, and process improvements, ensuring learnings reach the business within one quarter of exit.

Lead Customer Intelligence & AI

Own the multi-year vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform, defining what it becomes beyond a Customer Success tool: the single, trusted platform for customer insight that every GTM function draws on to understand and act on customer signal
Set the roadmap priorities for expanding Customer Health's reach: new data sources, new use cases, and new next-best-action and AI-driven experiences
Make the platform-level calls on scope, sequencing, and investment as Customer Health scales across functions, as we as align with cross-functional executives on the path forward
Ensure Customer Health and the Critical Accounts program reinforce each other: account health scores and signals should feed directly into critical account identification, triage, Get Well Plans, and portfolio reporting.
Drive cross-functional alignment across Product, Marketing, and GTM on how Customer Health orchestrates and surfaces insight: who gets alerted about which issues, when, and through which channel (internal vs. external), and how health data and alerts show up in the comms and UI layer for account teams, customers, and partners.

Provide Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the connective tissue across Customer, Product & Technology, Engineering, and GTM leadership for everything related to customer risk, intelligence, and intervention.
Give executives real-time, high-trust visibility into both the Critical Accounts and Customer Health portfolio

What You Will Bring

12+ years in Customer Success, Program Management, or Customer/GTM Operations, ideally in a consumption-based or B2B SaaS company, with several years in a people-management or senior program leadership role.
A track record of building a program or function from the ground up, not just running an existing one, including designing frameworks, standing up teams, and establishing executive reporting.
Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements under pressure; direct experience with a critical accounts, save, or escalation management program is strongly preferred.
Experience managing people leaders or senior individual contributors, with the judgment to set direction and hold others accountable without needing to run every workstream personally.
Strong cross-functional leadership without direct authority, and the ability to align Director- and VP-level peers across functions to a shared plan.
Executive-grade written and verbal communication; comfort presenting portfolio health, program KPIs, and business cases to senior leadership and, at times, the board.
Data-driven approach to management: builds and tracks KPIs rather than relying on status updates, and is comfortable reasoning about scoring, health signals, or model-driven recommendations even without an engineering background.
Familiarity with technical customer challenges (cloud, data infrastructure, or database preferred) and with how account teams actually work day to day.
High composure in high-stakes, ambiguous situations, with a bias toward bringing decisions and solutions rather than problems.

Nice to Have

Experience building and managing a Critical Accounts or similar escalation/save function, from designing entry/exit criteria and playbooks through running the portfolio day to day.
Experience owning or sponsoring an AI-powered customer intelligence, account health, or GTM tooling initiative spanning multiple functions.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Our client has served healthcare institutions for more than 30 years. Customers rely on it every day, and it is ready for its next chapter. They are looking for an engineering leader who has taken a mature, revenue-generating product and modernized it without disrupting the customers who depend on it, and who wants to do that again with real authority and a direct line to ownership.

About the Company

They are a healthcare education and informatics company with over 30 years in the market. Their platform is used by healthcare institutions across the United States and globally. They are small enough that one leader can shape how engineering works, and established enough that the work matters to a large base of loyal customers.

The Opportunity

The Head of Engineering owns the technical side of the business: the team, the platform, and the roadmap. You will report directly to ownership and serve as the primary technical voice in company leadership, with a seat at the table to guide overall company direction.
This is not a maintenance role, and it is not a greenfield startup. It is a modernization role. You will evolve a proven platform in place, making clear, pragmatic calls about what to rebuild, what to refactor, and what to leave alone, while keeping the product reliable for the customers who use it today.

This Role Is a Fit If You

Have led the modernization of an established product while customers kept using it, such as moving from self-hosted to cloud SaaS, consolidating fragmented products or services onto one platform, or re-architecting a legacy codebase
Still enjoy getting into architecture and code, even though parrt of your time goes to leading people
Have built and grown an engineering team, including hiring and developing leads or managers
Can explain technical tradeoffs to owners, sales, and customers in plain business terms
Want ownership and accountability in a smaller company rather than a narrow lane in a large one

What You'll Own

Platform modernization

Assess the current architecture and infrastructure, and build a pragmatic modernization roadmap
Lead migration and re-architecture work that balances near-term delivery with long-term technical health
Make the build, refactor, or retire decisions that keep the platform moving forward without putting customers at risk

Team leadership

Lead and develop the software engineering organization, including hiring, mentorship, performance management, and team structure
Establish and reinforce engineering processes: sprint planning, code review standards, incident response, and release management
Stay hands-on at the code and architecture level when needed, while empowering the team to own execution

Business partnership

Translate business goals into a technical roadmap and resource plan
Report directly to ownership and serve as the primary technical voice in leadership discussions
Partner closely with sales, marketing, and product so engineering priorities line up with what customers need

Quality, security, and reliability

Own the delivery of our software products and set the standards for quality, velocity, and reliability
Ensure the security, uptime, and compliance posture appropriate for a healthcare data company

What We're Looking For

5+ years of software development experience, with at least 2 years in engineering leadership
Experience in healthcare technology, EdTech, or subscription-based SaaS products
Hands-on experience modernizing an established software product (cloud migration, platform consolidation, re-architecture, or similar)
A proven track record building and scaling software teams
Strong engineering instincts: good architecture, clean code, and scalable systems
A track record of communicating with and gaining alignment from leadership and non-technical departments such as sales, marketing, and product
Comfort taking ownership of execution and results in a small to mid-sized, family-owned company

Nice to Have

Experience with security and compliance in regulated data environments
Technical due diligence or systems integration experience following an acquisition
Practical experience applying AI in engineering workflows or in the product
Degree in Computer Science or a related field

Why This Role

Real authority: you report to ownership and help set company direction, not just engineering direction
A product with staying power: three decades in market and a loyal customer base to build on
Visible impact: in a company this size, the platform and team you build will be clearly yours
Fully remote, with the flexibility that comes with it

jobs.title: Senior Director, Customer Health & Critical Accounts
jobs.description:
The Role

MongoDB is building two connected capabilities that determine how we protect and grow our most important customer relationships: a Critical Accounts program that catches at-risk accounts early and drives them to a durable resolution, and a Customer Health Platform, an AI-powered one-stop shop for customer insights, combining health, adoption, engagement, and experience data with proactive risk identification and recommended actions.

This role owns both. You will build and lead the Critical Accounts function end to end: the framework, the global operating model, and the executive reporting that gives leadership real-time visibility into the portfolio. You will also set the long-term vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform: what it scores and alerts on, which teams and use cases it serves next, and how it becomes the one-stop shop for customer insight across the company. You will be accountable for how MongoDB identifies, intervenes on, and learns from customer risk, and for where the Customer Health platform goes next.

This is a build role. You are creating the operating rhythm, the standards, and the team structure as much as you are running them.

This role can be based out of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

What You Will Do

Own and Build the Critical Accounts Program

Design and iterate on the global Critical Accounts framework: entry/exit criteria, account archetypes, playbooks, health assessment templates, and Get Well Plan standards.
Design the central Critical Accounts org structure and hire a lean program management team, establishing this as a durable, well-resourced function within Customer Strategy. This team is the connective tissue that ensures every qualifying account is triaged, resourced, tracked, and ultimately graduated with documented outcomes.
Own intake and triage standards so every qualifying nomination is validated, classified, and assigned a process lead and resource plan without delay.
Design the path for Critical Accounts to move beyond human nomination alone, working with Customer Health to define the signals and thresholds that proactively detect at-risk accounts and surface them for the cohort, so nominations come from both human judgment and the platform's early-warning detection.
Own program coordination: the master tracker of active critical accounts, cross-functional stand-ups with Customer Success, Technical Support, Professional Services, Sales, and Product and Engineering, the 90-day checkpoint process, and resource rebalancing as account needs evolve.
Own executive reporting for the program: weekly account status, monthly portfolio readouts with trend analysis, and quarterly summaries covering program KPIs, churn prevented, and cost-to-save ratios.
Set and track program KPIs, de-escalation rate, time-to-exit, CSAT delta, churn prevented, resource hours per account, and refine investment tiers based on actual data.
Lead post-mortem reviews for every graduated account and route findings into QBRs, product prioritization, and process improvements, ensuring learnings reach the business within one quarter of exit.

Lead Customer Intelligence & AI

Own the multi-year vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform, defining what it becomes beyond a Customer Success tool: the single, trusted platform for customer insight that every GTM function draws on to understand and act on customer signal
Set the roadmap priorities for expanding Customer Health's reach: new data sources, new use cases, and new next-best-action and AI-driven experiences
Make the platform-level calls on scope, sequencing, and investment as Customer Health scales across functions, as we as align with cross-functional executives on the path forward
Ensure Customer Health and the Critical Accounts program reinforce each other: account health scores and signals should feed directly into critical account identification, triage, Get Well Plans, and portfolio reporting.
Drive cross-functional alignment across Product, Marketing, and GTM on how Customer Health orchestrates and surfaces insight: who gets alerted about which issues, when, and through which channel (internal vs. external), and how health data and alerts show up in the comms and UI layer for account teams, customers, and partners.

Provide Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the connective tissue across Customer, Product & Technology, Engineering, and GTM leadership for everything related to customer risk, intelligence, and intervention.
Give executives real-time, high-trust visibility into both the Critical Accounts and Customer Health portfolio

What You Will Bring

12+ years in Customer Success, Program Management, or Customer/GTM Operations, ideally in a consumption-based or B2B SaaS company, with several years in a people-management or senior program leadership role.
A track record of building a program or function from the ground up, not just running an existing one, including designing frameworks, standing up teams, and establishing executive reporting.
Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements under pressure; direct experience with a critical accounts, save, or escalation management program is strongly preferred.
Experience managing people leaders or senior individual contributors, with the judgment to set direction and hold others accountable without needing to run every workstream personally.
Strong cross-functional leadership without direct authority, and the ability to align Director- and VP-level peers across functions to a shared plan.
Executive-grade written and verbal communication; comfort presenting portfolio health, program KPIs, and business cases to senior leadership and, at times, the board.
Data-driven approach to management: builds and tracks KPIs rather than relying on status updates, and is comfortable reasoning about scoring, health signals, or model-driven recommendations even without an engineering background.
Familiarity with technical customer challenges (cloud, data infrastructure, or database preferred) and with how account teams actually work day to day.
High composure in high-stakes, ambiguous situations, with a bias toward bringing decisions and solutions rather than problems.

Nice to Have

Experience building and managing a Critical Accounts or similar escalation/save function, from designing entry/exit criteria and playbooks through running the portfolio day to day.
Experience owning or sponsoring an AI-powered customer intelligence, account health, or GTM tooling initiative spanning multiple functions.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. jobs.title: Cyber - Operational Technology - Senior Manager - Consulting
jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Organizations are connecting industrial operations, modernizing control environments and integrating OT with enterprise technology. These changes create new cybersecurity, resilience and regulatory challenges across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors.

As an OT Cybersecurity Senior Manager in Technology Consulting, you will lead client engagements that assess, design and improve cybersecurity for Operational Technology and Industrial Control System environments. You will combine practical OT security knowledge with engagement leadership, client advisory, team development and business development. You will work across engineering, operations, cybersecurity and technology teams to help clients protect critical operations while supporting safety, availability and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead OT cybersecurity engagements, including maturity and risk assessments, architecture and configuration reviews, vulnerability assessments, security strategy, transformation roadmaps and implementation support.
Assess industrial environments that may include ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, SIS and IIoT technologies, industrial networks and supporting infrastructure.
Guide the design and implementation of practical OT security controls, including network segmentation, zones and conduits, defense in depth, system hardening, secure remote access, asset visibility, security monitoring and incident response capabilities.
Apply recognized OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82. Apply NIST CSF and sector-specific requirements when relevant to the client environment.
Lead client workshops and technical discussions with operational, engineering, cybersecurity and executive stakeholders. Translate technical findings into clear operational and business risk implications.
Manage engagement scope, workplans, resources, risks, quality, timelines and budgets. Keep client and EY stakeholders informed of progress and expected outcomes.
Lead, coach and develop engagement team members. Review deliverables and promote a collaborative, quality-focused and safety-aware working environment.
Build trusted client relationships and identify opportunities where EY can provide additional value.
Support business development through proposals, client presentations, solution shaping, methodology development, thought leadership and reusable assets.
Stay current on OT threat activity, industrial vulnerabilities, evolving regulations, security technologies and leading practices.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of industrial network architectures, industrial protocols and security controls used in OT environments.
Ability to turn technical observations into practical, prioritized recommendations that consider safety, availability, reliability and business continuity.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 8+ or more years of relevant cybersecurity, OT security, industrial automation or related experience.
Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.
Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCNA or comparable credentials.
Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

What We Look For

We are looking for professionals who combine OT and ICS technical credibility with practical consulting judgment. Successful candidates communicate clearly, collaborate across engineering, operations and cybersecurity teams, and deliver high-quality outcomes in complex industrial environments.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

The salary range for this job is:
New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $204,800 to $425,500
Bay Area California offices – $213,300 to $443,200
All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $170,600 to $390,000

Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Organizations are connecting industrial operations, modernizing control environments and integrating OT with enterprise technology. These changes create new cybersecurity, resilience and regulatory challenges across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors.

As an OT Cybersecurity Senior Manager in Technology Consulting, you will lead client engagements that assess, design and improve cybersecurity for Operational Technology and Industrial Control System environments. You will combine practical OT security knowledge with engagement leadership, client advisory, team development and business development. You will work across engineering, operations, cybersecurity and technology teams to help clients protect critical operations while supporting safety, availability and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead OT cybersecurity engagements, including maturity and risk assessments, architecture and configuration reviews, vulnerability assessments, security strategy, transformation roadmaps and implementation support.
Assess industrial environments that may include ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, SIS and IIoT technologies, industrial networks and supporting infrastructure.
Guide the design and implementation of practical OT security controls, including network segmentation, zones and conduits, defense in depth, system hardening, secure remote access, asset visibility, security monitoring and incident response capabilities.
Apply recognized OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82. Apply NIST CSF and sector-specific requirements when relevant to the client environment.
Lead client workshops and technical discussions with operational, engineering, cybersecurity and executive stakeholders. Translate technical findings into clear operational and business risk implications.
Manage engagement scope, workplans, resources, risks, quality, timelines and budgets. Keep client and EY stakeholders informed of progress and expected outcomes.
Lead, coach and develop engagement team members. Review deliverables and promote a collaborative, quality-focused and safety-aware working environment.
Build trusted client relationships and identify opportunities where EY can provide additional value.
Support business development through proposals, client presentations, solution shaping, methodology development, thought leadership and reusable assets.
Stay current on OT threat activity, industrial vulnerabilities, evolving regulations, security technologies and leading practices.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of industrial network architectures, industrial protocols and security controls used in OT environments.
Ability to turn technical observations into practical, prioritized recommendations that consider safety, availability, reliability and business continuity.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 8+ or more years of relevant cybersecurity, OT security, industrial automation or related experience.
Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.
Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCNA or comparable credentials.
Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

What We Look For

We are looking for professionals who combine OT and ICS technical credibility with practical consulting judgment. Successful candidates communicate clearly, collaborate across engineering, operations and cybersecurity teams, and deliver high-quality outcomes in complex industrial environments.

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

Job Description

Sr. Manager, Engineering - FI Data Solutions

The Role

FI Data Solutions team is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Client Master Data Management (MDM) platform and translate product strategy into prioritized engineering roadmaps, technical deliverables, and execution plans. Operating with an enterprise mindset, this role collaborates across business units to align priorities, shape shared roadmaps, and deliver integrated solutions that balance localized needs with broader organizational outcomes. The role is accountable for platform strategy, engineering execution, and operational excellence for the Client MDM ecosystem.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

Ability to translate complex business vision and strategy into actionable engineering plans, roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs
Strong enterprise perspective with success driving cross-functional alignment and integrated, scalable solutions
Expertise in modern engineering practices, platform architecture, and system design to optimize performance and efficiency
Proven ability to influence technical and architectural decisions that improve business and customer outcomes
Experience developing data-driven business cases and conducting technology readiness assessments
Strong awareness of industry and technology trends, with the ability to evaluate and recommend adoption opportunities
Demonstrated success in defining and implementing technology standards and governance practices
Effective collaboration with Product and Vendor Managers to evaluate, select, and integrate external solutions
Strong vendor management capabilities, optimizing partnerships with both external providers and internal teams
Commitment to operational excellence, including proactive contingency planning to ensure system reliability and availability
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field

The Team

FI Data Solutions team is part of the FI Product and Business Enablement Technology (FIPBET) responsible for Data Management, Analytics and Shared Platform capabilities. Our diverse portfolio represents a broad set of business-critical capabilities that span revenue generation, operational execution and strategic decision support. Our team sits at the intersection of core business processes and enterprise data, enabling both operational processing and advanced analytics delivery.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.
