The Opportunity at Altana

You'll lead a team of enterprise Sales Engineers and own the technical side of Altana’s enterprise sales motion. You'll be at the forefront of our sales initiatives, playing a crucial role in translating technical jargon into practical value for our clients and partners. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with partners in Sales, Revenue Enablement, Account Management, Product Marketing, and Product Management in order to shape the entire customer journey, including how we run discovery, what a great demo looks like, how a proof of concept is scoped and judged, and how what we learn in the field makes its way back into the product.

This role requires a perfect blend of technical acumen and interpersonal skills, as you will be tasked with presenting our innovative solutions to diverse audiences, ranging from technical contributors to executives.

This is primarily a people-leadership role. You won't be the default SE on deals. However there will be times when you’ll have to step into an IC role, and you’ll need to be enough of a product expert to demo the product or run a POV.

This role reports to the Head of Enterprise.

You Will

Lead and grow the team

Hire, onboard, and ramp SEs as the Enterprise business scales
Define role expectations and a career path so each SE knows what good looks like and what comes next
Coach each SE through growth plans and direct feedback, drawn from watching them in live customer engagements

Define how Sales Engineering works in the sales process

Set the standard for discovery into a customer's trade compliance or supply chain process, and partner with AEs to turn it into a business case
Own our demo narratives — the story we tell for each product and use case, and how it shifts for a compliance analyst versus a Chief Supply Chain Officer
Own our POV methodology: entry criteria, success criteria, process, and how results get presented back
Own the customer value journey from signature to realized value, including the handoff to Account Management and every commitment made during the evaluation
Travel 25-50% depending on deal flow, for customer meetings, on-site workshops, and time in the field with your team

Own the technical practice

Build and maintain demo environments for each industry we sell into
Build and maintain the documentation library: technical collateral, reference architectures, reusable demo flows, and security and RFP content
Keep the team fluent as the product line expands, partnering with Revenue Enablement to make every release demo-ready
Become a subject matter expert in trade compliance and supply chain

Close the loop with Product

Own the field-to-product feedback pipeline so the roadmap reflects what the market is asking for
Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, messaging, and competitive content
Represent Sales Engineering in cross-functional initiatives

You Have

5–8 years in sales engineering or solutions consulting, plus 2+ years directly managing sales engineers — hiring, ramping, and performance-managing them
A track record of coaching technical, customer-facing people from competent to excellent — you can walk us through how you've developed someone
Hands-on implementation experience — you've configured a tenant, untangled messy customer data, and chased bugs in a live deployment
Credible depth in enterprise pre-sales: complex, multi-stakeholder evaluations at six-figure-plus ACV, including security, data, and procurement review
The ability to lead a technical deep dive — architecture, integration strategy, InfoSec, PSR — and tell a compelling product story to a business audience. If you lean one way, tell us how you've built a team that covers the other
Experience standing up an AI-driven pre-sales approach — using AI tools to make an SE team measurably faster
Fluency in enterprise data architecture: data models, integration and ingestion patterns, APIs, cloud infrastructure
Credibility with a data engineer and a Chief Supply Chain Officer in the same afternoon
Clear judgment about when a deal is winnable, and the willingness to say so
More satisfaction from your team's win than from your own demo
Nice to Have: Domain familiarity with supply chain, global trade, logistics, or customs

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY or Washington, DC with hybrid work flexibility. We prefer candidates within commuting distance of one of our offices, but will consider remote US-based candidates who are a strong match.

US Salary Range And Benefits

$200,000 - $230,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range, to the extent specified for this role, is a good faith statement of the minimum and maximum levels of the annual based salary for the position. The base salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on a wide range of compensation factors, including, but not limited to, work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Altana's total compensation package. Altana also offers either a discretionary bonus or a variable compensation plan depending on the role. Additionally, Altana offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Flexible Time Off: Altana operates with a Flexible Time Oﬀ (FTO) policy that gives you agency over your own time oﬀ so you can maximize your work-life balance.
Parental Leave: We oﬀer industry leading Paid Parental Leave (PPL), providing 14 weeks of leave for non-birthing, adoptive, and foster parents and up to 26 weeks of leave for birthing parents, all paid at 100% of your base salary.
Health Benefits: We have a full suite of medical, vision, and dental benefits with generous employer contributions, designed to give you flexibility and choice for your individual health situation. Our high deductible health plan is 100% employer paid for employees and supplemented with an employer contribution to your Health Savings Account (HSA). There is also a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) option.
Supplemental Benefits: Altana provides life, short- and long-term disability, and AD&D insurance coverage, all at no cost to you, so you know that you and your loved ones are covered in case of an emergency.

Commuter Benefits: Save money on your commute by setting aside pre-tax funds for public transit or parking!
Wellness: Because we value mental and emotional health, every Altana employee has access to a free premium subscription to Calm, the #1 app for meditation, sleep, and mindfulness.
Pet Insurance: Pets are family too! Keep them healthy with Wishbone insurance and / or our Total Pet vet service and telehealth discount plan.
Employee Assistance Program: Free access to confidential personal support.
Dependent Care FSA: You will have access to a Dependent Care FSA, which allows you to set aside pre-tax funds for childcare expenses

Our Values

Our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.They form the foundation of Altana’s culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers.

Trust: Our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. We honor that by keeping our word, meeting commitments, and ensuring every action we take reinforces confidence in us. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable.
Resilience: In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It’s how we respond when things don’t go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward.
Stewardship: We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. We believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission.
Courage: Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. It’s the core value that drives us make bold moves and take on big, complicated network problems—the ones others avoid. We know success isn't guaranteed, but we have the audacious vision to believe a solution is possible and to build it. Courage fuels our growth mindset. It means embracing challenges that make us stronger, and it’s demonstrated by how we approach hard conversations and complex projects.

At Altana, we believe that a diverse workforce enables greater creativity, performance, and adaptability. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome you to join us as you are. new_jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Agentic & Generative AI Benchmarking and Evaluations
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Advanced Technology Group (ATG) at ServiceNow is a customer-focused innovation group building intelligent software and smart user experiences using existing and latest advanced technologies to enable end-to-end, industry-leading work experiences for customers. We are a group of researchers, applied scientists, engineers, and product managers with a dual mission. We build and evolve the AI platform, and partner with teams to build products and end-to-end AI-powered work experiences. In equal measure, we lay the foundations, research, experiment, and de-risk AI technologies that unlock new work experiences in the future.

Job Description

We are seeking an exceptional, data-driven Senior Engineering Manager, Agentic & GenAI Benchmarking and Evaluations
to establish and lead AI evaluation practices for both ServiceNow and our customers. As ServiceNow shifts enterprise workflows from simple generation to complex, autonomous agents, ensuring system reliability, safety, and accuracy is paramount.

In this role, you will lead a specialized team of AI evaluation engineers and data scientists. Your team will build the infrastructure, rigorous validation frameworks, and benchmarks that quantify the performance of Now Assist agentic workflows across multi-step orchestration, tool-calling, and enterprise-grounded reasoning. You will bridge the gap between frontier AI research and hard production metrics, directly impacting the trust and adoption of autonomous workflows for millions of enterprise users.

What You Get To Do In This Role

Build the Evaluation Infrastructure: Design, own, and scale automated testing and evaluation harnesses (unit evals, integration evals, and production drift monitors) to measure agent quality and eliminate regressions.
Define Enterprise AI Benchmarks: Create standard, repeatable evaluation frameworks tailored to complex business workflows—assessing multi-agent orchestration, intent routing, multi-step planning loops, and long-term memory accuracy.
Validate Grounding & RAG Pipelines: Partner with search and data fabric teams to systematically evaluate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, hybrid search, and semantic re-ranking systems.
Model Selection Optimization: Rigorously benchmark frontier LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and proprietary ServiceNow models) to evaluate trade-offs across execution capabilities, latency, context-window efficiency, and inference costs.
Lead a High-Performing Team: Recruit, mentor, and foster an AI-native engineering team, driving engineering best practices, prompt-infrastructure stability, and production-grade rigor.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with Core Product, Machine Learning Platforms, and Engineering leads to translate baseline performance statistics into actionable product improvements and model fine-tuning targets.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

8+ years of professional software engineering or machine learning experience, including 3+ years managing or technically leading high-performing AI/ML teams.
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
Strong foundational knowledge of frontier AI SDKs and deep experience deploying or testing agentic/probabilistic software architectures (multi-agent orchestration, tool execution, and probabilistic feature deployment).
Demonstrated experience implementing rigorous AI metrics (e.g., ROUGE, BLEU, G-Eval, LLM-as-a-judge patterns, and custom deterministic evaluation code) at an enterprise scale.
Proficiency in Python and familiarity with data analytics infrastructures (SQL, Pandas, NumPy) alongside standard MLOps tracking platforms.
Experience with complex knowledge infrastructure, SaaS platform architectures, or relational datasets (e.g., Knowledge Graphs, CMDBs).
Ability to translate deeply technical evaluation data into executive-level risk assessments, ROI summaries, and strategic roadmap recommendations.
Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a highly quantitative field (Master's or Ph.D. is a plus).

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $201,300 - $352,300
, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

new_jobs.description:
Company Description
Walk On Ventures (WOV) is a strategic growth advisory and venture firm that partners with founders and executive teams building high-impact companies. Operating at the intersection of performance marketing, insurtech, and agentic AI, WOV embeds directly with leadership to create operating leverage and accelerate outcomes. The firm provides strategic advisory services, performance marketing expertise, AI-driven solutions, and venture investment support for companies designed to scale. WOV’s approach is grounded in real operating experience, emphasizing practical, high-impact collaboration that drives growth, builds enterprise value, and supports complex inflection points. The “Walk On Mentality” reflects a culture of initiative, preparation, and consistently outperforming expectations for every client engagement.

new_jobs.description:
The Role

MongoDB is building two connected capabilities that determine how we protect and grow our most important customer relationships: a Critical Accounts program that catches at-risk accounts early and drives them to a durable resolution, and a Customer Health Platform, an AI-powered one-stop shop for customer insights, combining health, adoption, engagement, and experience data with proactive risk identification and recommended actions.

This role owns both. You will build and lead the Critical Accounts function end to end: the framework, the global operating model, and the executive reporting that gives leadership real-time visibility into the portfolio. You will also set the long-term vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform: what it scores and alerts on, which teams and use cases it serves next, and how it becomes the one-stop shop for customer insight across the company. You will be accountable for how MongoDB identifies, intervenes on, and learns from customer risk, and for where the Customer Health platform goes next.

This is a build role. You are creating the operating rhythm, the standards, and the team structure as much as you are running them.

This role can be based out of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

What You Will Do

Own and Build the Critical Accounts Program

Design and iterate on the global Critical Accounts framework: entry/exit criteria, account archetypes, playbooks, health assessment templates, and Get Well Plan standards.
Design the central Critical Accounts org structure and hire a lean program management team, establishing this as a durable, well-resourced function within Customer Strategy. This team is the connective tissue that ensures every qualifying account is triaged, resourced, tracked, and ultimately graduated with documented outcomes.
Own intake and triage standards so every qualifying nomination is validated, classified, and assigned a process lead and resource plan without delay.
Design the path for Critical Accounts to move beyond human nomination alone, working with Customer Health to define the signals and thresholds that proactively detect at-risk accounts and surface them for the cohort, so nominations come from both human judgment and the platform's early-warning detection.
Own program coordination: the master tracker of active critical accounts, cross-functional stand-ups with Customer Success, Technical Support, Professional Services, Sales, and Product and Engineering, the 90-day checkpoint process, and resource rebalancing as account needs evolve.
Own executive reporting for the program: weekly account status, monthly portfolio readouts with trend analysis, and quarterly summaries covering program KPIs, churn prevented, and cost-to-save ratios.
Set and track program KPIs, de-escalation rate, time-to-exit, CSAT delta, churn prevented, resource hours per account, and refine investment tiers based on actual data.
Lead post-mortem reviews for every graduated account and route findings into QBRs, product prioritization, and process improvements, ensuring learnings reach the business within one quarter of exit.

Lead Customer Intelligence & AI

Own the multi-year vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform, defining what it becomes beyond a Customer Success tool: the single, trusted platform for customer insight that every GTM function draws on to understand and act on customer signal
Set the roadmap priorities for expanding Customer Health's reach: new data sources, new use cases, and new next-best-action and AI-driven experiences
Make the platform-level calls on scope, sequencing, and investment as Customer Health scales across functions, as we as align with cross-functional executives on the path forward
Ensure Customer Health and the Critical Accounts program reinforce each other: account health scores and signals should feed directly into critical account identification, triage, Get Well Plans, and portfolio reporting.
Drive cross-functional alignment across Product, Marketing, and GTM on how Customer Health orchestrates and surfaces insight: who gets alerted about which issues, when, and through which channel (internal vs. external), and how health data and alerts show up in the comms and UI layer for account teams, customers, and partners.

Provide Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the connective tissue across Customer, Product & Technology, Engineering, and GTM leadership for everything related to customer risk, intelligence, and intervention.
Give executives real-time, high-trust visibility into both the Critical Accounts and Customer Health portfolio

What You Will Bring

12+ years in Customer Success, Program Management, or Customer/GTM Operations, ideally in a consumption-based or B2B SaaS company, with several years in a people-management or senior program leadership role.
A track record of building a program or function from the ground up, not just running an existing one, including designing frameworks, standing up teams, and establishing executive reporting.
Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements under pressure; direct experience with a critical accounts, save, or escalation management program is strongly preferred.
Experience managing people leaders or senior individual contributors, with the judgment to set direction and hold others accountable without needing to run every workstream personally.
Strong cross-functional leadership without direct authority, and the ability to align Director- and VP-level peers across functions to a shared plan.
Executive-grade written and verbal communication; comfort presenting portfolio health, program KPIs, and business cases to senior leadership and, at times, the board.
Data-driven approach to management: builds and tracks KPIs rather than relying on status updates, and is comfortable reasoning about scoring, health signals, or model-driven recommendations even without an engineering background.
Familiarity with technical customer challenges (cloud, data infrastructure, or database preferred) and with how account teams actually work day to day.
High composure in high-stakes, ambiguous situations, with a bias toward bringing decisions and solutions rather than problems.

Nice to Have

Experience building and managing a Critical Accounts or similar escalation/save function, from designing entry/exit criteria and playbooks through running the portfolio day to day.
Experience owning or sponsoring an AI-powered customer intelligence, account health, or GTM tooling initiative spanning multiple functions.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

Overview

At Quorum Software, our Product Managers lead the charge in innovating and executing new products and features. We are looking for a platform-minded leader to own the Quorum Upstream & Midstream Platform — the shared data, integration, and services layer that Quorum's energy applications are built on. Its scope spans the Quorum Agentic Platform, ontology-based data products, document and knowledge management, and a unified portal layer that serves as the surface access point to key platform capabilities. This role is for someone who can dive into an industry, conduct research to gain key market insights, create use cases, and build consensus and business cases around platform opportunities. Our Product Managers work closely with all areas of the organization to drive vision and strategy, define roadmaps, and deliver products that meet our user and business objectives. If you have a track record of building and delivering platform products, advocating for both the internal teams who build on your platform and the external customers who consume it, and successfully guiding new product ideas from concept to launch, we welcome you to apply!

Responsibilities

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Quorum Upstream & Midstream Platform, spanning the shared data and integration layer, the Quorum Agentic Platform, ontology-based data products, document and knowledge management, and the unified portal layer that provides surface access to key platform capabilities
Identify market problems and use cases specific to data platforms serving the energy value chain; define market requirements by conducting market research supported by ongoing visits to customers and attending conferences and tradeshows
Balance the needs of two distinct customer sets: the internal application teams who build on the platform, and the external customers and partners who consume its data, APIs, and services
Create and maintain product roadmaps, driven by the overall strategy, including ideas, features, and initiatives as they progress through approval and release
Partner with Finance, Strategy and Sales on packaging and pricing for platform capabilities — including subscription, consumption, and entitlement models — and help build the business case that ties platform investment to commercial outcomes
Remain current on data platform and software industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, and ensure that Quorum products align with these new developments
Establish and maintain the competitive landscape, which allows us to make informed decisions based on strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities in the marketplace
Identify and prioritize opportunities that align with corporate strategy and will result in increased product sales, customer retention, and increased efficiency (e.g., reduced support and/or implementation requirements)
Define and track platform adoption and health metrics — such as API consumption, data volumes, tenant onboarding time, and the delivery velocity of teams building on the platform
Create a culture of innovation based on product improvement and data-informed decision making, and set expectations for engineering teams to deliver value
Work with product development team to define product release user stories and requirements, with marketing to define the go-to-market strategy, with sales channels to drive understanding of the product positioning, key benefits, and target customer
Evangelize vision for the platform both within the organization and externally to the industry; communicate clearly within the organization the market problems and user personas
Develop and maintain product documentation and user guides, including developer- and API-facing documentation
Work closely with Engineering Lead to ensure clear communication throughout release cycle
And other duties as assigned

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree preferably in Engineering or Computer Science
Minimum of eight years of experience in Product Management with SaaS, cloud, or enterprise B2B products
Demonstrated experience with data platform products — data integration and pipelines, APIs, ontology or common data models, master data, or analytics and reporting enablement
Proven track record of building and delivering platform products, including owning a platform roadmap that serves both internal application teams and external customers
Working knowledge of one or more of the platform's core domains, with the ability to ramp quickly on the rest: agentic and AI platform capabilities (agent orchestration, tool and API invocation, evaluation and guardrails), ontology-driven data products, document and knowledge management (unstructured content, search and retrieval, governance), or unified portal and shared user experience layers
Experience defining a unified portal or shared experience layer that surfaces capabilities from multiple underlying products and services, including navigation, identity, entitlements, and a consistent user model across applications
Some knowledge or experience with platform pricing and packaging, such as consumption-based, tiered, or entitlement-based models, and how platform investment translates into commercial value
Knowledge or experience in the Energy industry, with some experience in the Upstream sector
Demonstrated ability to scale existing products into new/adjacent markets and geographies
Demonstrated technical prowess including solving complex problems, working knowledge of SQL and modern data architectures (cloud data warehouses, APIs, event streaming, microservices), and familiarity/understanding of systems architecture
Experience in interpreting and defining product requirements
Experience in working directly with development teams
Excellent communication skills to include internal/external interaction with varying background and roles, documentation, and presentations
Understanding of various software applications and/or methodologies (Agile and Scrum)
Full-cycle product management capabilities, including developing roadmaps, establishing goals, writing specifications, monitoring release execution, and defining rollout strategies (preferred, but not required)
Experience using Azure DevOps (preferred, but not required)
Fluent in English, both written and verbal

new_jobs.title: Director of Finance Technology and Transformation
new_jobs.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your impact on our mission

We’re looking for a highly analytical, technically minded builder to lead the evolution of the technology and processes that power financial planning and decision making at Zocdoc.

In this role, you’ll own the strategy, roadmap, and continuous improvement of Finance Technology across Strategic Finance and FP&A, with a particular focus on planning and forecasting. You’ll own modernizing our enterprise planning platform, systematize workforce planning, improve reporting and decision support, and define practical ways to use automation and AI across Finance.

You'll partner closely with Strategic Finance, FP&A, Finance Systems, Accounting, Data & Analytics Engineering, HR Systems, and IT to translate Finance business needs into scalable technology solutions.

You will define the planning technology roadmap and oversee the business workflows that the technology enables. The opportunity is to build a more scalable Finance Technology capability while remaining close to the day-to-day problems and decisions of the business.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

A builder who enjoys improving planning systems, processes, and technology to solve complex business problems.
A pragmatic operator who can deliver useful improvements quickly while designing for a scalable future state.
Comfortable working at the intersection of Finance, Technology, Data, People, and Operations.
Energized by workforce planning, scenario modeling, and the messy cross-functional dependencies behind headcount and compensation planning.
Passionate about using automation and AI to reduce manual work, improve forecast quality, and help Finance make better decisions.
Comfortable partnering with Finance leaders, Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Data, IT, HR Systems, Recruiting, and external software vendors.
A structured problem solver who can navigate ambiguity, prioritize competing opportunities, and drive complex cross-functional initiatives.
Opinionated enough to challenge assumptions while remaining collaborative and practical about tradeoffs.
A clear communicator who can translate technical concepts into business outcomes for Finance and executive stakeholders.

Your day to day…

Own the strategy, roadmap, governance, and ongoing evolution of Finance Technology across Strategic Finance and FP&A, including enterprise planning (Planful), forecasting systems, planning processes, reporting capabilities, automation, and AI enablement.
Build a scalable approach to workforce planning across Finance, Recruiting, People Systems, senior leadership, and hiring managers to best support financial planning and companywide strategic planning.
Partner closely with Finance leadership and senior executives across the business including Product, Technology, and HR to understand business needs, identify opportunities to improve planning capabilities, and prioritize Finance Technology investments.
Evaluate Finance technology investments, including enterprise planning capabilities, automation opportunities, AI tools, and build-versus-buy decisions, developing recommendations for Zocdoc leadership.
Translate Finance business requirements into technology roadmaps, partnering with Finance Systems, Data & Analytics Engineering, HR Systems, IT, and external vendors to deliver scalable solutions.
Lead the implementation, integration, configuration, adoption, and optimization of planning and forecasting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring planning, forecasting, reporting, data-ingestion, variance-analysis, and commentary workflows.
Evaluate practical uses of AI within existing Finance systems and processes, with appropriate consideration for data quality, security, compliance, controls, and adoption.
Establish governance and best practices for planning systems, financial models, forecasting processes, data ownership, testing, and change management.
Lead cross-functional technology initiatives from business case through implementation, driving stakeholder alignment, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
Support strategic initiatives and high-priority projects that strengthen Finance’s ability to scale alongside the business.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

10+ years of experience in FP&A, Finance Systems, Corporate Finance, Finance Transformation, or another analytical role supporting financial planning technology.
Experience owning Finance technology strategy, including enterprise planning systems, forecasting processes, and the technology roadmap supporting financial planning.
Experience leading one or more enterprise planning system implementations or major enhancements (Planful, Adaptive, Pigment, Anaplan, or similar).
Deep understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling processes.
Experience translating Finance business requirements into technology strategy and partnering with Finance Systems, Data & Analytics Engineering, HR Systems, IT, and external vendors to deliver scalable solutions.
Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
Experience evaluating Finance technology investments, automation opportunities, and emerging AI capabilities to improve planning processes and team productivity.
Strong project management, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to prioritize competing initiatives and drive measurable business outcomes.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business recommendations for Finance and executive leadership.
Relevant experience in technology, SaaS, healthcare, or marketplace businesses is a plus.

Benefits

Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient Soho location
Unlimited Vacation
100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)
Commuter Benefits
401(k) with employer funded match
Corporate wellness program with Wellhub
Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)
Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
Cell phone reimbursement
Catered lunch everyday along with beverages and snacks
Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging

Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. new_jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Organizations are connecting industrial operations, modernizing control environments and integrating OT with enterprise technology. These changes create new cybersecurity, resilience and regulatory challenges across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors.

As an OT Cybersecurity Senior Manager in Technology Consulting, you will lead client engagements that assess, design and improve cybersecurity for Operational Technology and Industrial Control System environments. You will combine practical OT security knowledge with engagement leadership, client advisory, team development and business development. You will work across engineering, operations, cybersecurity and technology teams to help clients protect critical operations while supporting safety, availability and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead OT cybersecurity engagements, including maturity and risk assessments, architecture and configuration reviews, vulnerability assessments, security strategy, transformation roadmaps and implementation support.
Assess industrial environments that may include ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, SIS and IIoT technologies, industrial networks and supporting infrastructure.
Guide the design and implementation of practical OT security controls, including network segmentation, zones and conduits, defense in depth, system hardening, secure remote access, asset visibility, security monitoring and incident response capabilities.
Apply recognized OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82. Apply NIST CSF and sector-specific requirements when relevant to the client environment.
Lead client workshops and technical discussions with operational, engineering, cybersecurity and executive stakeholders. Translate technical findings into clear operational and business risk implications.
Manage engagement scope, workplans, resources, risks, quality, timelines and budgets. Keep client and EY stakeholders informed of progress and expected outcomes.
Lead, coach and develop engagement team members. Review deliverables and promote a collaborative, quality-focused and safety-aware working environment.
Build trusted client relationships and identify opportunities where EY can provide additional value.
Support business development through proposals, client presentations, solution shaping, methodology development, thought leadership and reusable assets.
Stay current on OT threat activity, industrial vulnerabilities, evolving regulations, security technologies and leading practices.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of industrial network architectures, industrial protocols and security controls used in OT environments.
Ability to turn technical observations into practical, prioritized recommendations that consider safety, availability, reliability and business continuity.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 8+ or more years of relevant cybersecurity, OT security, industrial automation or related experience.
Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.
Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCNA or comparable credentials.
Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

What We Look For

We are looking for professionals who combine OT and ICS technical credibility with practical consulting judgment. Successful candidates communicate clearly, collaborate across engineering, operations and cybersecurity teams, and deliver high-quality outcomes in complex industrial environments.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

The salary range for this job is:
New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $204,800 to $425,500
Bay Area California offices – $213,300 to $443,200
All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $170,600 to $390,000

Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

new_jobs.title: Head of Architecture & Platform Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Who are we?

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

What will you contribute?

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead the architecture, modernization, and scalability of Finastra's Lending technology platform. As the Head of Lending Architecture & Platform Engineering, you will define the technology vision and architectural strategy for Lending products, driving platform transformation, cloud adoption, AI enablement, and engineering excellence. This role combines strategic leadership with deep technical expertise to ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, and high-performing SaaS solutions that support business growth and innovation.

Responsibilities & Deliverables

Your deliverables as a Head of Lending Architecture & Platform Engineering will include, but are not limited to, the following:

Technology & Architecture Leadership

Define and own the overall architectural vision, technical strategy, and long-term scalability of the platform.
Establish and enforce architectural principles, patterns, and governance across lending engineering teams.
Drive modernization of legacy systems, including re-architecture, cloud migration, refactoring toward microservices or modular architectures.

Platform Engineering

Lead the development of shared platform services, frameworks, and tooling that support all product teams (e.g., identity, observability, CI/CD, logging, infrastructure as code).
Build and scale internal platforms that improve developer productivity, system performance, and operational efficiency.
Partner with central teams to enforce security, resilience, and compliance at the platform level.

AI Enablement

Collaborate with the chief AI officer team and lead the definition of the framework and patterns needed to operationalize AI models in Lending products
Establish architectural guardrails for model training, inference, explainability, and performance at scale.
Ensure AI components are standardized, secure, compliant, and cost effective across Lending products and environments (on-prem, cloud)
Drive the adoption of AI tech (eg CoPilot) within the engineering teams with the focus on enhancing productivity and time to market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate closely with product engineering, infrastructure, security, and data teams to align technical architecture with business goals.
Serve as a technical thought partner translating product goals into robust technical solutions.
Participate in roadmap planning, capacity management, and cross-team architectural reviews.
Present architecture roadmaps and trade-offs to executive leadership and technical teams

Technology Operations & Governance

Support high-availability operations for products, shared services and platform capabilities.
Own key architectural decisions related to performance, reliability, observability, cost, and maintainability.

Team Management & Enablement

Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of platform engineers and architects.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.
Define team goals, OKRs, and performance metrics aligned with company objectives.

Required Experience

Proven software engineering experience and technical leadership or architecture roles.
Deep experience designing scalable, distributed systems and cloud-native architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
Proven success leading platform or infrastructure teams supporting developer tools, shared services, or internal platforms.
Strong understanding of AI driven and modern application development practices (CI/CD, containers, microservices, IaC, observability).
Experience designing and scaling platforms that support AI use cases
Deep understanding of AI platforms, model lifecycle management, and AI compliance practices.
Prior experience modernizing monolithic or legacy applications
Familiarity with compliance and security requirements in cloud environments (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR, AML, KYC, etc).
Hands-on experience with tools such as Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Prometheus/Grafana, or similar.
Experience leading engineering transformation or platform evolution at an enterprise level.

Benefits

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

Flexibility:
Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

Well‑being:
Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

Health & Financial Security:

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering and Delivery
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM
is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As Senior Manager, Platform Engineering & Delivery, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for advancing how software is built, tested, secured, packaged, and delivered across SiriusXM. You will lead the Delivery team while remaining actively engaged in architecture, engineering design, prototyping, technical reviews, and solving complex delivery challenges alongside the engineers you lead.

You will also be advancing Agentic Delivery
: evolving our software delivery platform so AI agents can perform increasingly complex parts of the software development lifecycle—including coding, testing, validation, remediation, and delivery—based on human direction and within well-defined engineering, security, and operational guardrails. You will help define the architecture, platform capabilities, standards, and controls required to make agent-driven software delivery safe, reliable, observable, and scalable across the enterprise.

You will also own and evolve the foundational delivery capabilities that engineering teams and agents depend on, including CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain security, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Your goal will be to create a delivery platform that makes the secure and reliable path the easiest path, whether the work is being performed by a human engineer, an AI agent, or a combination of both.

This is a player-coach role. You will provide people leadership and strategic direction, but you will also be expected to stay close to the technology, evaluate and improve technical designs, contribute to technical solutions, and directly help move important initiatives forward.

What You’ll Do

Lead the evolution toward Agentic Delivery: Define and execute the technical strategy for enabling AI agents to safely perform software delivery work based on human intent. Build the platform capabilities, APIs, workflows, context, permissions, feedback loops, and guardrails needed for agents to write code, run tests, remediate issues, validate changes, and progress software through delivery workflows.
Remain hands-on technically: Work directly with engineers on architecture, system design, prototypes, technical investigations, and complex implementation challenges. Review code and designs where appropriate, validate technical approaches, and help establish reference implementations for new delivery capabilities.
Own the software delivery architecture: Set technical direction across CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain controls, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Ensure these capabilities work together as a coherent delivery platform rather than as disconnected tools.
Design for both human and agent consumers: Evolve delivery systems so workflows can be used consistently through developer interfaces, APIs, automation, and AI agents. Ensure delivery capabilities expose the context, controls, telemetry, and machine-readable interfaces required for increasingly autonomous engineering workflows.
Create secure, reusable paved paths: Develop and drive adoption of standardized delivery patterns that reduce one-off implementations, improve developer productivity, and embed security, compliance, reliability, and observability into the default workflow.
Advance CI/CD and release engineering: Improve development feedback loops, pipeline performance, release reliability, and consistency across engineering teams. Identify bottlenecks and use automation, platform engineering, and AI where appropriate to remove unnecessary manual work.
Strengthen software supply chain security: Partner with Information Security to integrate code scanning, dependency controls, artifact integrity, vulnerability management, provenance, policy enforcement, and other secure-by-default controls directly into CI pipelines and delivery workflows.
Standardize artifacts: Establish scalable patterns for how packages and build outputs are created, secured, stored, promoted, traced, and consumed across environments.
Use engineering data to drive improvement: Establish metrics around pipeline performance, adoption, failure rates, developer wait time, release reliability, agent effectiveness, remediation outcomes, and other delivery signals. Use those metrics to prioritize platform improvements and measure their impact.
Lead and develop the Delivery team: Provide clear technical and organizational direction, coach engineers and technical leads, build leadership capability, manage performance, and create an environment where engineers can take meaningful ownership of complex platform problems.
Drive cross-functional technical alignment: Work closely with Developer Experience, Cloud, Observability, Information Security, application engineering, and other stakeholders to solve cross-cutting delivery problems and establish common engineering standards.
Own roadmap and investment decisions: Translate engineering and business needs into a prioritized roadmap, balancing strategic platform investment, operational reliability, technical debt, developer productivity, security, and cost.
Evaluate emerging technologies pragmatically: Continuously assess new approaches in AI-assisted development, agentic engineering, CI/CD, software supply chain security, and developer tooling. Prototype where appropriate and turn successful experiments into production-grade platform capabilities.

What You’ll Need

Typically 7 or more years of software engineering or platform engineering experience, including 3 or more years leading engineering teams or technical organizations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong hands-on technical background. You should be comfortable going deep on architecture, reviewing technical designs, reading and reviewing code, building prototypes, debugging complex systems, and working directly with engineers to solve difficult platform problems.
Experience designing modern software delivery systems, with strong knowledge of one or more of the following: CI/CD platforms, GitHub Actions or similar workflow systems, artifact repositories, developer tooling, code quality platforms, software supply chain security, or security scanning in CI pipelines.
Strong software engineering skills. Experience designing and building production software, automation, APIs, platform services, or developer tooling in one or more modern programming languages.
Experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development. Understanding of how coding agents, LLM-based engineering tools, tool-calling agents, or similar systems can participate in the software development lifecycle. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is strongly preferred.
Ability to reason about the architecture of Agentic Delivery systems, including context and tool access, permissions, human approval points, policy enforcement, isolation, auditability, observability, feedback loops, and safe execution of autonomous actions.
Deep understanding of CI/CD and software delivery architecture, including build and test automation, security scanning in CI pipelines, release workflows, artifact promotion, environment management, deployment patterns, and the operational concerns associated with running these systems at enterprise scale.
Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including secure build practices, dependency and vulnerability management, artifact integrity, provenance, policy enforcement, and shifting security controls earlier in the development lifecycle through CI pipelines.
Strong cloud and platform engineering fundamentals, preferably with experience operating large-scale systems on AWS and working with infrastructure-as-code and distributed systems.
Technical leadership and judgment. Ability to make architecture decisions, evaluate technical designs and trade-offs, identify where standardization creates leverage, balance short- and long-term considerations, and guide engineers through ambiguous technical problems.
People leadership. Proven ability to coach and develop engineers and technical leads, manage performance, build healthy teams, delegate effectively, and develop future technical and organizational leaders.
Cross-functional influence. Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, security, product, and senior leadership; communicate complex technical topics clearly; and drive adoption of standards across teams you do not directly manage.
Operational and product mindset. Ability to treat internal platform capabilities as products, measure adoption and outcomes, understand developer needs, prioritize based on impact, and continuously improve the experience of engineers using the platform.
Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $106,600 to $200,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager
new_jobs.description:
Care.com is a consumer tech company with heart. We’re on a mission to solve a human challenge we all face: finding great care for the ones we love. We’re moms and dads and pet parents. We have parents and grandparents so we understand that everyone, at some point in their lives, could use a helping hand. Our culture and our products reflect that.

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our Pricing and Growth engineering team. You will manage a full-stack team of 10 to 12 engineers who build the systems that decide what families and caregivers pay, how we package and present our offerings, and how we measure what works. This is a growth role: your team's output is judged by its effect on conversion, revenue and retention.

The role has high visibility. You will work directly with senior executives, explain technical tradeoffs in business terms, and turn experiment results into decisions. You will also stay close to the code and the tech stack, so you can guide architecture and review technical work.

What You Will Do

Lead a team of 10 to 12 full stack engineers responsible for pricing, packaging, promotions and growth experiences across our web and mobile products.
Set the technical roadmap for pricing and growth with Product, Finance, Marketing and Data partners, and tie each priority to a measurable business outcome.
Present strategy, progress and results to executives, including tradeoffs, risks and the expected return on engineering investment.
Stay hands-on: review code and designs, help debug production issues, and contribute directly when the team needs it.
Build and run an experimentation practice that includes A/B testing, feature flags, clear success metrics and guardrails, so the team can ship pricing changes quickly and read the results with confidence.
Design and maintain the services that hold pricing rules, plans, discounts and promotions, and make sure they stay accurate, auditable and consistent with billing and payments systems.
Partner with Finance and Compliance so pricing changes meet regulatory, tax and financial reporting requirements.
Work with architects to break up legacy platform components and move core pricing capabilities to an event-driven architecture.
Champion engineering best practices across the domain, including observability, testing, performance, scalability and security.
Recruit, mentor and develop engineers, and build a team culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Oversee on-call practices, SLAs and incident management to keep the platform resilient and available.

Qualifications

8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
3+ years leading engineering teams as an Engineering Manager or Team Lead, including experience managing a large team or multiple teams.
A track record of delivering growth, pricing, monetization, subscription or checkout work in a consumer-facing product.
Experience running experiments and using data to decide what to build next.
Strong hands-on technical skills across the full stack, and enough familiarity with our stack to take part in design and code review. Experience with Java or Golang is required.
Experience with AWS and microservices architecture is a plus.
Working knowledge of billing and payment systems, and of payment security and compliance such as PCI-DSS, is a plus.
Proven ability to communicate with executives and cross-functional leaders, and to explain technical decisions in terms of business impact.
Experience delivering large-scale, consumer-facing systems in a fast-paced environment.
A demonstrated ability to recruit, inspire and grow engineering talent.
Location: Austin or Dallas Texas candidates are highly preferred; we are hybrid, MW&T in office

Additional Information

Company Overview: Available in more than 20 countries, Care.com is the world's leading platform for finding and managing high-quality family care. Care.com is designed to meet the evolving needs of today's families and caregivers, offering everything from household tax and payroll services and customized corporate benefits packages covering the care needs of working families, to innovating new ways for caregivers to be paid and obtain professional benefits. Since 2007, families have relied on Care.com's industry-leading products—from child and elder care to pet care and home care.

Salary Range: $180,000 to $200,000. The base salary range above represents the anticipated low and high end of the national salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to work location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Care.com’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonuses and short- and long-term incentives. In addition, Care.com provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a generous 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO).

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

Our STaaS (Storage-as-a-Service) NoSQL & Blob platform team sits within Cloud & Production Engineering and partners closely with Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM), Product & Technology (P&T), DTS, and PLG. The team builds and operates the foundational NoSQL and object storage platforms that power Docusign's global agreement workflows, spanning Azure (Cosmos DB, Blob Storage, GovCloud), Google Cloud (Firestore, GCS), and emerging multi-cloud capabilities. We hire people with a broad set of skills who want to work on platform solutions at scale, while ensuring world-class reliability, security, and cost efficiency for our storage and data platforms. Docusign is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our NoSQL & Blob STaaS platform team. This role owns the strategy, delivery, and operations of our core NoSQL and blob storage services, including availability, performance, security, and cost optimization across Azure and Google Cloud. You will lead a high-impact engineering team responsible for: Defining and delivering multi-cloud storage abstractions and APIs that decouple product teams from specific cloud substrates. Owning SLOs, incident response, and RCAs for our NoSQL and blob platforms, in partnership with SRE, security, and compliance. Driving deprecations and migrations (for example, legacy Cassandra, MongoDB, or Cosmos DB patterns) to modern, governed platform offerings. Establishing strong partnerships with Microsoft and Google for roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and joint incident management.

This position is a people manager role reporting to the Senior Director, Engineering.

Responsibility

Build and lead a sustainable, high-performing engineering team through hiring, coaching, retention, and thoughtful organizational design
Define and execute a multi-year strategy for NoSQL & Blob STaaS that balances operational excellence (SLOs, incidents, DR, cost) with platform roadmap (APIs, abstractions, deprecations, migrations)
Own the reliability, availability, and performance of our NoSQL and blob platforms
Partner with architecture, security, and compliance to define and enforce guardrails
Lead platform initiatives that reduce risk and cost
Collaborate with partner teams (product engineering, SRE, finance, security, and vendor partners)
Manage the engineering lifecycle for the team
Conduct design and code reviews and raise the technical bar for distributed storage systems
Ensure high-quality engineering practices, including testing, automation, observability, and capacity planning
Define and track engineering KPIs (for example, incident counts, MTTR, SLO adherence, cost efficiency) and drive continuous improvement
Create a culture of learning, experimentation, and ownership that encourages engineers to tackle hard problems in distributed systems, storage, and multi-cloud infrastructure

Job Designation

Hybrid:
Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building large-scale, highly available distributed systems or data platforms
5+ years of experience as an engineering manager leading backend, infrastructure, or platform teams
Experience designing or operating NoSQL and/or blob storage systems (for example, Cosmos DB, Cassandra, Firestore, DynamoDB, Azure Blob, GCS, S3 or equivalents)
Experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure and/or Google Cloud), containers (Docker), and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes
Experience in at least one modern programming language (for example, C#, Java, Go, or similar) and infrastructure-as-code and automation
Experience driving cross-team initiatives, including incident management, RCAs, and systemic reliability improvements

Preferred

Deep expertise in public cloud storage and data platforms, especially Azure (Cosmos DB, Blob, GovCloud) and Google Cloud (Firestore, GCS)
Experience building or owning platform abstractions that decouple application teams from specific cloud providers (for example, internal APIs, SDKs, or storage gateways)
Experience with cost optimization for storage and data platforms, including lifecycle management, archival strategies, and capacity planning
Familiarity with security and compliance requirements for data at scale (for example, encryption, key management, network isolation, and governance in regulated environments)
Experience leading teams responsible for mission-critical services with 24x7 availability, including on-call programs and SRE practices
Working knowledge of DevOps practices and tooling (for example, CI/CD, observability stacks, configuration management)
Experience working with or within large platform organizations, and with cloud vendors, on joint roadmap and incident efforts
A track record of building inclusive, high-trust teams and mentoring engineering leaders
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of partnering with product, operations, and leadership stakeholders

Wage Transparency

Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations:

Washington, Maryland, New Jersey and New York (including NYC metro area): $178,900.00 - $262,825.00 base salary

This Role Is Also Eligible For The Following

Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre-established sales goals. Non-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance.
Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Benefits

Global benefits provide options for the following:

Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region
Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement
Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment
Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions
Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.
